tei:div.tei:p: gnyis kyi ming 'dogs dngos ni/ lan gnyis kyi snga ma ni/ a bh+ya sa'i ming can dang*/ snga phyi gnyis ka ni/ a bh+yāsta'i ming can yin pas/ ming gang byung du ming don 'dres par byas nas/ bya ba gang bshad pa rnams bya'o/ /'o na/ a bh+yāsta'i ming can yin na/byings gnyis brjod pa'i cha shas yin pas khyab bam zhe na/ ma khyab ste/ dzak+ṣa sogs kyi byings lnga po rnams ni/ gnyis ma brjod kyang*/ a bh+yāsta'i ming can yin pas so/ /lnga gang zhe na/ dzak+ṣa za ba dang rgod pa/ dzā gṛ gnyid sad/ da ri drā 'gro ba ngan/ tsa kā sṛ 'bar/ shā su rjes su ston pa la'o zhes pa rnams so// des na/ byings de rnams la warta mā na'i an+ti/ an bi/ de ata sogs las 'jig

byings kyi dzā gṛ'i ṝ dang da ri drā'i a ring gnas shing*/ mtha' gzhan gsum rjes 'brel byas/ gnas pa gnyis la rim pa bzhin a bh+yā sa'i ṛ'i yi ge ra'o dang*/ a bh+yāsta rnams kyi ā yig go zhes pas ā dbyi ba byas/ thams cad la a bh+yasta las an+ti'i na yig med do zhes pa rnams byas pas/ dzak+ṣa ti/ dzā gra ti/ da ri dra ti/ tsa kā sa ti/ shā sa ti/ gnyis pa ni/ shri dru sru zhes sogs kyi skabs su bshad pa'i a d+ya tā nī'i cha shas tsaṇa dang*/ pa ro3k+ṣā bco brgyad po dang*| tse krī yi ta'i ming can ya sgra dang*/ byings kyi cha shas gong du brjod pa'i san gyi mtha' can rnams la byings lan gnyis brjod pa'i bya ba'o/ /de tsam du/ zad dam zhe na/ min te/ hu sbyin pa la'o zhes pa'i byings a bh+yā sa'i cho ga byas pa'i grub 'bras/ dzu ho ti dang sogs pa/ nyi bhī 'jigahṛ ngo tsha/ dur sing du| dza na skye ba yang smos te/ de rnams la sogs pa'i byings kyi pha rol tu/ rnam dbye byings thams cad pa byung ba la yang*/ byings lan gnyis brjod pa'i cho ga rnams bya dgos pas so/ /de ltar na byings lan gnyis brjod dgos pa lnga ste/ mdo 'di'i bstan don gcig dang*/ snga ma'i bstan don bzhi'o/ /'di rnams kyi dper brjod ni mang du brjod cing*/ brjod par yang 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa la gsal byed kyi dang*/ dbyangs kyi dang*/ de gnyis ka'i chog ga'o/ /dang po ni byings lan gnyis kyi snga ma ni/ a bh+yā sa yin la/ de'i cho ga ji ltar bya snyam na/ gsal byed dang po dbyangs dang bcas pa/ lhag mar byas nas/ gzhan dbyangs gsal gang yod kyang dbyi bar bya zhing*/ 'dis ni gtso bor gsal byed 'phyid pa nyid/ dngos su bstan no/ /ya dza lha mchod/ ḍu pa tsa ṣa 'tshed/ tum san 'jig gnyis brjod/ 'dis dza dang tsa dbyi/ san la a yig gi'o/ /zhes pas a yig ir bsgyur/ a bh+yasta'i cho ga ni/ bhṛ dza sogs rnams kyi ṣaṣ'o//

tsa sde'i 'dra ba'i yi ge min pa la ki'o/ ṣa ḍha dag gi sa la ka'o/ /rgyu mtshan las zhes sogs kyis sa'i ṣa rnams sngar bzhin byas shing*/ san gyi mtha' las snga ma bzhin nos ti/ an bi/ yi yak+ṣa ti/ pi pak+ṣa ti/ a bh+yā sa'i gsal byed phyis pa'i lhag ma yin na/ dang po'i gsal byed yin pas ma khyab ste/ dang po shiṭa yin zhing*/ de'i de ma thag na/ sgra med yod na shiṭa las pha rol gyi sgra med pa de/ dbyangs dang bcas pa lhag mar byas nas/ gzhan rnams 'phyid pas so// dper na/ sh+ts+yu tir 'gyur byed/ ir rjes 'brel/ s+phur ts+tshā rjed pa la'o/ ā yig ni āta rjes su 'brel pa las kyang ngo zhes pa'i rtags don/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i aṭa/ gnyis brjod/ 'dis tsa yig pha yig dbyangs bcas lhag mar byas/ gnyis pa bzhi pa zhes pas pha'i pa thung ngu yon tan/ tsush+ts+yo ta/ pus+phūr+ts+tsha/ de bzhin du stan+bhu/ skan+bhumado'i byings la sngar ma ltar bsgrubs/ ta stam+bha/ tsa skam+bha/ a bh+yā sa'i gsal byed sde pa'i gnyis pa dang/ bzhi pa dag ni/ rang rang gi dang po dang gsum pa dag tu 'gyur ro/ khar+d+da za/ phak+ka dal bus 'gro ya sgra gnyis brjod/ gsal lhaga'adis kha ka dngapha pa ru bsgyur/ ka sde'i tsa sde'o/ /te/ an bi/ tsa khar+d+da ya te/ pa phak+ka ya te/ ngh+rai tshim/ dzha dza dang*/ bhṛ dzi rngod pa la'o/ /i yig ni/ ita rjes su 'brel ba min pa rnams kyi rtags don du bzhed do/ /de yang de'i shes byed las/ de rjes su 'brel pa la nu ā ga ma byed pa'o/ /tum/ san 'jig |mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i mtha' rnams kyi bi ka ra ṇa min pa la ā yig go |gsal byed mtha' las iṭa/ gnyis brjod/ thung ngu*/ ṛ yig gi a yigasan la de i yiga'adi'i cho ga byas/ ti/ an bi/ di dh+rā ṣa ti/ dzi dzha dzi ṣa ti| bi bhṛñji ṣa ti/ a bh+yā sa'i ha yig gang yin pa rnams ni dza yig tu bsgyur ro// ha ya 'gro har+ya sbrid/ aṭa gnyis brjod/ gsal lhaga'adis ha'i dza/ a'i u pa dhā ring po/

dza hā ya/ dza har+ya/ kak+kha dang*/ gha rgod pa la'o// zhes sogs a bh+yā sa'i/ ka sde lnga po rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ tsa sde/ lnga po rnams su bsgyur bar bya ste/ dper brjod sla'o/ /'on kyang des ma khyab ste/ ka ba ti'i ming can/ kung sgra la'o zhes pa 'di'i ku ni tse krī yi ta la tsa ru bsgyur ba min pas/ ko kū ya te| zhes pa'i grub 'bras 'byung ste/ ā bh+yā sa'i tse krī yi ta la yon tan dang*/ a bh+yasta ni/ nā mi mtha' rnams kyi yaṇa ā shīṣa tse krī yi ta rnams la ya ring po'o zhes pa byas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ḍu dānya sbyin pa dang*/ pā btung ba sogs kyi a bh+yā sa'i ring po rnams ni thung ngur bsgyur bar bya'o/ /de gnyis la aṭa/ ā yig las aṭa'i au zhes pas aṭa au ru bsgyur/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge la'o zhes pas/ de la ā phyis pas/ da dau pa pau/ de bzhin du ḍhau kṛ daṇ+ḍa ka'i byings lta bu'i a bh+yā sa rnams thung ngur ji ltar bya snyam na/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge rnams kyi thung ngur bsgyur ba ni/ ita uta dag go zhes bshad pas/ e ke sha yod med gnyis i thung dang o ke sha yod med gnyis u thung ngu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /dper na| ḍu ḍhau ka a bh+yā sa'i ṛ yig ni a yig tu bsgyur bar bya ste| kṛ ṣa rnam par rko ghṛ ṣu yang dag par dga'/ pa ro3k+ṣa'i aṭ/ gnyis brjod/ 'dir ṛ a yon tan/ bya ba gzhan rnams sngar bzhin byas pas/ tsa kar+ṣa/ ga ghar+ṣa/ mṛ ṣu bzod| a tus/ us/ pa ro3k+ṣā la 'ang ngos yon tan med/ ma mṛ ṣa tuḥ ma mṛ ṣuḥ in 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings 'di las grub pa'i a bh+yā sa ni/ rkyen pa ro3k+ṣā la/ de yang de'i pa rasmai'i gcig tshig gsum la yon tan yod la/ gzhan thams cad la yon tan med pas/ yon tan med pa rnams la dbyangs ring por 'gyur ba'o/ /iṇa 'gro a tus/ gnyis brjod dbyangs la gnyis brjod pa byas pa na dbyangs kyi cho gas zhes pas/ 'dis ring po/

iṇa'i 'ang ngo*/ /zhes pas/ a bh+yasta ya nyid du bsgyur bas/ ī ya tuḥ a bh+yā sa'i dang po'i yi ge a yig tu yod pa gang yin pa de ring por bsgyur ba ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā yon tan yod med thams cad la bya'o/ /aṭa/ brtson/ aṭa/ a tus/ gzhan 'gre/ ā ḍa/ ā ḍa tuḥ gsum pa la pa ro3k+ṣā la dang*/ byings thams cad pa la dang*/ san mtha' la dang*/ tse krī yi ta la dang*/ in tsaṇa la brten pa'i lus 'gyur ra/ོ/ dang po ni pa ro3k+ṣā la brten nas a bh+yā sa'i a yig ring por byas pa gang yin pa de las pha rol gyi dang por na yig ā ga ma 'gyur te/ gal te mtha' brtsegs pa yin na'o/ /a 'tshe/ aṭa/ a tus/ gnyis brjod dang po'i a'i thams cad du'ang ngo*/ /'dis na byangs med ā ga ma/ ā na/ ān tuḥ de 'dra de las pha rol ṛ yig la'ang de'i dang por na ā ga ma 'gyur la/ de las pha rol tu/ ash+no ti'i ming can a shu khyab pa la'o zhes pa 'di'i a bh+yā sa las kyang*/ a bh+yasta'i dang por na ā ga ma'o/ /ṛ nghu 'phel/ a shu khyab/ a tus/ ṛ yig gi a yig de ring po sogs byas pas/ ā nṛ ngha tuḥ ā na sha tuḥ bha wa ti'i ming can/ bhū yod pa'i byings kyi/ a bh+yā sa'i dbyangs ni/ a nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /bhu yod/ aṭa/ a tus/ bhū'i pa ro3k+ṣā la/ ba ā ga ma byas pas/ ba bhū ba/ ba bhū ba tuḥ gnyis pa ni/ byings ni dzir gtsang*/ bi dzir tha dad/ bi ṣl̥ khyab/ ir gnyis dang l̥ rjes 'brel du byas pa rnams kyi/ a bh+yā sa ni/ byings thams cad pa sde tshan bzhi po pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur te/ byings de gsum re re la yang ti/ yāta/ tu/ di/ an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jig des na gnyis brjod/ 'dis a bh+yā sa dang*/ u pa nghā nā min zhes pas/ a bh+yasta yang yon tan/ 'on kyang sap+ta mī'i yāta la yang ngo zhes pas de la yon tan bkag di'i i phyis shing*/ da yang brtsegs pa'i mtha' dbyi ba dang*/ tshig mtha'i sha yang*| ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las/

zhes 'byung sa mthun pas/ tshig mthar nghuṭa rnams kyi dang po'/ོ/ zhes pas ṭa ru bsgyur/ gzhan cho ga spyi dang mthun par byas pas/ ne nek+ti/ ne ni dz+yat/ ne nek+tu/ a ne neka be bek+ti/ be bidz+yāta/ be bek+tu/ a be beka be beṣ+ti/ be biṣ+yāta/ be beṣ+tu/ a be beṭa/ de bzhin du/ ḍu bhṛnya 'dzin/ o hāng 'gro/ māng tshad la ste sgra la'o/ /zhes pa'i 'di byings rnams kyi| a bh+yā sa'i dbyangs ni/ byings thams cad pa la it ces pas i thung ngu'o// dang po la ti/ yāta/ tu/ di/ snga ma bzhin dang*/ 'di dang khyad par/ rkyen gyi ma phyis pa'i rjes kyi ra yig rnam bcad du btang bas/ bi bharti/ bi bhṛ yāta/ bi bhar+su/ a bi bhaḥ byings phyi ma gnyis la/ byed pa po dang ru tsa sogs ces pas sde tshan bzhi'i āt+ma ne'i/ te/ īta/ tām/ ta/ cho ga gzhan snga ma bzhin la a bh+yasta rnams kyi ā yig go zhes pas sap+ta mī la ā dbyi zhing*/ gzhan gsum la gnyis ka rnams kyi dā min pa ni gsal byed la/ ī yig go zhes pas/ mtha' ā rnams ni ī ru bsgyur bas/ dzi hī te/ dzi hīta/ dzi hī tām/ a dzi hī ta/ ṛ 'gro ba la'o zhes pa'i lus 'gyur/ arti dang*/ pṛ skyong ba la'o'i lus 'gyur/ pi parti zhes pa 'di dag gi a bh+yā sa yang i nyid du 'gyur ro/ /byings de gnyis la| ti/ yāta/ tu di/ a bh+yā sa rnams ni 'dis i yig dang*/ byings snga ma la a bh+yā sa'i 'dra ba'i yi ge min pa la'os/ i ya dang*/ a bh+yasta ni/ yāta las/ gzhan la by-ings gnyis kar yon tan dang yāta la yon tan med pas/ snga ma la mtshams sbyor zhing*/ byings phyi ma la ṝta mtha'i yon tan med pa la ir ro// mchur 'gyur u pa nghā'i ur ro zhes pas ṛ ur du bsgyur zhing*/ nā min gyi ra ba dag la/ gsal byed la ste kur tshur dag gi min no zhes pas/ de ring por btang ba rnams byas pas/ i yarti/ i yāta/ i yartu/ ai yaḥ phyi ma 'di la dbyangs dang po rnams kyi dang po'i 'phel ba'o//

zhes pa byas pa'o/ /pi pirta/ pi pur+yāta/ pi partu/ a pi paḥ 'di la'ang byings kyi dang por/ aṭa dang brtsegs pa'i mtha' phyis nas ra rnam bcad da/ོ/ gsum pa ni byings san gyi mtha' can la/ a bh+yā sa a'i yi ger yod pa rnams/ i ru bsgyur ba'o// ḍu pa tsa ṣa 'tshed/ wa tsa brjod/ tum san 'jig gnyis brjod sogs/ ti an bi sogs/ pi pak+ṣa ti/ bi bak+ṣa ti/ dza dang mthar gnas bzhi dang*/ pa sde ā'i yi ge can/ pha rol la u yig gi a bh+yā sa ni/ i nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o// dzu mdo'i byings/ yu bsre/ ru sgra lūnya gcod/ pūnya dag bhū yod/ mūng 'ching*| byings las kyang rgyu la'os in 'phel/ au ā wa tum/ kā ri ta ni/ āṃ iṭa bi ka ra ṇa min pa la'o zhes pas/ tum la de 'jigatum mtha'i byings las san/ tum 'jig zhig rting bya ba yang log pas/ kā ri ta 'jugasan la iṭa/ yon tan/ in la byas pa ni gnas can dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro zhes pas/ rtsa ba'i byings yon tan ma byas pa rnams nyid gnyis brjod a bh+yasta rnams in la 'phel ba/ de rnams ā war bsgyur rting*/ mdo 'di'i bya ba gnas par 'gyur bas/ a bh+yā sa'i u yig rnams i yig go/ de rting ti an bi/ dzi dzā ba yi ṣa ti/ yi ya ba yi ṣa ti/ ri rā ba yi ṣa ti/ li lā ba yi ṣa ti/ pi pā ba yi ṣa ti/ bi bhā ba yi ṣa ti/ mi mā ba yi ṣa ti/ mdo 'di la pa sde pha rol can ā'i yi ge la u'i yi ge'o zhes pa 'gyur mi bde bas/ dza dang mthar gnas dang*| pa sde a'i yi ge can pha rol la u'i yi ge'o/ /bzhi pa ni tse krī yi ta pha rol la/ a bh+yā sa'i cho ga ji ltar bya snyam na/ ar dang mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge snga ma nyid gnyis dag kyang yon tan no/ /zhes pas/ byings i u ṛ gsum yod pa'i a bh+yā sa rnams ni/ tse krī yi ta pha rol la de dag gi yon tan e o ar gsum du 'gyur zhing*/ a yig thung ngu ā ga ma med pa rnams ni/ ring por 'gyur ba'o/

/shu ts+yī dang shu ts+yī mngon par skye/ ī yig ni/ ḍīng shīng sogs kyi don dbyangs gcig pa'i zhes pas ya sgra/ gnyis brjod/ 'dis yon tan/ tse krī yi ta'i mtha' las so/ /zhes pas/ te/an bi/ dbyi/ sho shu te/ tso tsu te| de bzhin du tsa pa zhi/ ya sgra/ gnyis brjod/ gsal lhaga'adis ring po ste/ an bi/ dbyi/ tsā tsa pya te/ wan tsi zhes pa/ bañcu daṇ+ḍa ka'i byings/ shran+si/ bh+ra khan+si/ dh+wa kan+si/ ka si pa ti pa di skan+d-i zhes pa rnams la/ byings mdor/ shran+su dang bh+ran+su 'og tu ltung*/ ngh+wan+su dang ka sa dang*/ pa dang*/ pa da rnams 'gro/ skan+di skems pa la'o zhes pa yod la/ 'di rnams nas ṛ ldan pa'i ṛ'o'i bar la byings mtha' rjes 'brel/ dbyangs gcig pa'i zhes pas ya sgra dang*/ pha rol tu tse krī yi ta'i mtha' las so zhes pas te an bi/ a dang mtshams sbyor gyi sogs dang*/ pañci sogs kyi a nu ṣaṃ ga rnams/ ita rjes su 'brel pa min pa rnams kyi yon tan med pa la a nu ṣaṃ ga dbyi ba dang*/ gnyis brjod nas/ a bh+yā sa'i bya ba gang bshad pa rnams bya zhing*/ khyad par byings 'di rnams kyi/ a bh+yā sa'i mthar/ nī ā ga ma dang*/ ka ṇa dang ra ṇa 'gro ba la'o zhes pa lta bu'i byings rjes su sna ldan mtha' can gyi ata mtha'i a bh+yā sa'i mthar/ rjes su nga ro ā ga ma dang*/ rjes su sna ldan mtha' can min kyang*/ dza pa yid/ dza bha lus nyams| da ha thal bar byed/ dan+sha mche ba/ bhañjo nyod/ pa sa 'gro ba la'o zhes pa| dza pa sogs rnams kyi/ a bh+yā sa'i mthar yang rjes su nga ro dang*/ tsa ra 'gro| pha la rdzogs zhes pa/ tsar phal dag gi a bh+yā sa'i mthar yang rjes su nga ro ā ga ma ste/ tsar phal gyi a bh+yā sa'i pha rol/ a bh+yasta'i a'i uta du bsgyur bar bya la/ dṛ shir blta/ nṛ tī lus po skyod pa lta bu/ ṛ ldan pa'i a bh+yā sa'i mthar| ra la ī ring po zhugs pa'i rī ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ wa nī wa ts+ya te/

sa nī sra pya te/ da nī dh+wa s+ya te/ ba nā bh+ra s+ya te/ tsa nī ka s+ya te/ pa nī pa t+ya te| pa nī pa d+ya te/ tsa nīska d+ya te rnams dang*/ tsaṃ ka ṇ+ya te dang raṃ ra ṇ+ya te dang*/ dzaṃ dza s+ya te/ dzaṃ dza bh+ya te| daṃ da h+ya te/ daṃ da sh+ya te/ baṃ bha dz+ya te/ paṃ pa s+ya te rnams dang*| tsaṃ tsu d+ya te dang*| paṃ phu l+ya te dang*/ da rī dṛ sh+ya te/ na rī nṛ t+ya te rnams so// lnga pa ni/ bcu rnams mtshungs pa'o zhes pa'i mtshungs pa'i ming can gyi yi ge ma phyis na/ yang ba'i yi ge pha rol la/ in kā ri ta las pha rol tu byung ba'i/ tsaṇa la yang*/ san gyi bya ba byed pa'i sgo nas/ san bzhin du 'gyur zhing*/ yang ba'i a bh+yā sa ring por 'gyur ro/ /ḍukṛnya/ pa ṭha klogabyings las kyang rgyu la'os in dang*/ de'i bya ba bya/ a d+ya ta nī'i di/ aṭa/ kā ri ta las tsaṇa/ de la kā ri ta dbyi/ phyis nas bya ba yang log pas/ tsaṇa la byings lan gnyis/ a bh+yā sa'i bya ba sngar bzhin byas rting san la a yig gi i/ yang ba'i ring po/ tsaṇa dang bcas pa'i di la/ nā min gyi mtha'i yon tan/ a tsī ka rata/ a pī pa ṭhata/ de bzhin du lūnya gcod/ bhū yod/ de gnyis la snga ma ji lta ba bzhin/ khyad par dza dang mthar gnas kyi cho ga byas pas/ a lī la bta/ a bī bha bta/ byings twa rā sogs bdun po rnams kyi/ a bh+yā sa'i yang*/ in las pha rol gy-i tsaṇa la a yig tu 'gyur ba'o/ /nyi tā ra mgyogs/ pra tha gtam/ mra da nya ded/ smṛ sems/ tṛ 'jigs/ s+tṛnya 'gebs/ spṛ sha regarnams ni tā rā sogs bdun te/ de rnams kyi byings mtha'i dbyangs gsal rjes 'brel byas/ in/ di/ aṭa/ tsaṇa| dbyi/ gnyis brjod/ 'dis a bh+yā sa'i dbyangs a yig tu bsgyur bas/ a ta twa rata/ a pa pra thata/ a ma mra data/ a pa sma rata/ a ta sta rata/ a ta sta rata/ a pa spar+ṣata/ bzhi pa ni mdo 'di nas le'u rdzogs kyi bar la/ a bh+yā sa dbyi bar bya'o/ /de yang san gyi mtha' can gzhir byas la/
byings ḍu minya 'phen| mīng 'tshe/ mā dang māng 'jal/ ḍu dānya sogs/ dā'i ming can kun dang*/ ra bha rtsom/ ḍu la bhaṣa thob/ shakl̥ nus/ pa

dang pa da 'gro ba/ zhes pa 'di rnams kyi a bh+yā sa dbyi zhing*/ a bh+yasta'i dbyangs ni is su bsgyur bar bya'o// byings yi ge re re ba ma gtogs pa'i mtha'i dbyangs gsal rjes 'brel/ kun la tum/ san 'jigaganyis brjod/ a bh+yā sa dbyi zhing*/ a bh+yasta'i dbyangs kun is su byas/ de'i sa dang san gyi sa gnyis bar du gzhan med pa rnams/ sa'i sa la byings thams cad pa min pa la ta'o zhes pas sa dang po ta ru bsgyur ba dang*/ bha dpang ka sogs bar du chod pa'i sa dang po rnams ni/ brtsegs pa'i dang po sa ka dag gi mtha' la'ang ngo zhes pas dbyi/ bha dang da sogs ni/ sgra med pa rnams la shiṭa min pa rnams kyi dang po'o/ /zhes pas/ pa dang ta yig tu bsgyur ba dang*/ gzhan thams cad sngar bzhin byas nas/ mit+sa ti/ gsum dang*/ dit+sa ti/ rip+sa ti/ lip+sa ti/ shik+ṣa ti/ pit+sa ti/ gnyis rnams te/ ti/ an bi/ an 'jig pa byas pa'o/ /āp+no ti/ zhes pa/ āpl̥ khyab pa la'o/ /zhes pa 'di'i san la/ a bh+yā sa dbyi zhing*/ dbyangs ī ru bsgyur bas/ īp+sa ti/ dan+bhi'i ming can dan+bhu tshul 'chos pa la'o zhes pa/ 'di'i gzhan 'dra ba la ī dang*/ ita du yang 'gyur zhing*/ byings kyi gsum pa dang po zhes pa'i bya ba byas pas/ nghip+sa ti/ dhīp+sa ti/ da ya ti'i ming can dang*/ srung ba la'o zhes sogs kyi byings ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā pha rol la/ di gi zhes par 'gyur/ snga ma brtsegs pa min pa'i yi ge'i ya ste| yi ge gcig nyid min pa'i 'o zhes pas/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i e sogs la/ di gi'i gi'i i ya ru bsgyur bas/ di gye sogs so/ /kun bshad par rkang pa gsum pa'i bshad pa rdzogs so// //bzhi pa la saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dngos dang*/ zhar la rnam 'gyur rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la thob pa la sgrub pa dang*/ mi thob pa la dgag pa'o// dang po la gang zhig 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang*/ gang la 'gyur ba'i rkyen no/ /dang po ni/ 'dir saṃ pra pā ra ṇa zhes pa 'di'i rangabazhin gang/

gang las der 'gyur zhe na/ rang bzhin gsal byed dbyangs dang bcas pa cig dbyangs rkyang pa gcig tu song ba yin la de yang*/ tsan+d+ra par/ ya ṇar bsgyur ba zhes dang*/ 'dir mtshams sbyor gyi skabs su/ /i ṛ u l̥ rnams 'dra ba'i yi ge min pa la rim pa bzhin du| ya ra wa lar 'gyur ba bzhin du/ mthar gnas pa'i ming can ya ra la wa rnams pha rol de ma thag pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pa rnams rim pa bzhin du/ i ṛ l̥ u rnams su gyur pa ni/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa zhes bya ste/ gang du de'i ming byung sar de dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la a bh+yasta'i dang*/ a bh+yā sa'i dang*/ so sor ma phyed pa'i saṃ pra sā ra ṇa bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni gra ha sogs byings dgu ste/ gra hi dang*/ dz+yā dang*/ wa yi dang*/ bya dhi dang*/ waṣ+ti dang*/ bya tsi dang*/ prats+tshi dang/ brash+tsi dang*/ bh+ras+dzi rnams kyi mthar gnas dbyangs dang bcas pa ni/ yon tan med pa'i ti sogs kyi rkyen la saṃ pra sā ra ṇar 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang gra ha nye bar len| dz+yā lang tsho nyams/ de gnyis la te/ yaṇa bi/ 'dis saṃ pra pā ra ṇa/ gṛh+ya te| dzī ya te/ benya snal ma'i rgyud/ in dang nya dang zhes pas/ a tus/ benya'i 'ang wa yi'o zhes pas/ de pa ro3k+ṣā la wa yir bsgyur/ yi'i i brjod don/ 'dis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa gnyis brjod/ mtshungs 'dra/ ū ya tuḥ bya dha bsnun/ wa sha mdzes/ bya tsa zol/ prats+tsha shes par 'dod/ o brash+tsu gcod/ bh+ras+dza 'tshed/ te| yaṇa/ 'dis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa/ dhuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas/ bh+ras+dzi'i sa ni gsum pa da ru 'gyur te/ l̥ tu la sa so las 'byung*/ zhes gnas mtshungs pas bzhag pa ste/ gzhan du'ang dran par bya'o/ /ta sde'i tsa ṭa'i sde pa zhes pas da dza ru bsgyur bas/ bi dh+ya te/ u sh+ya te/ bi ts+ya te/ pṛts+tsh+ya te/ bṛsh+ts+ya te/ bhṛ te'o// yang na/ gra ha dang dz+yā la/ krī sogs las nā/ bya dhi la/ di ba sogs las yan dang*| gzhan rnams las an bi dang bcas pa'i ti dang*/ dzi la de mtha' ring po byas pas gṛh+ṇāti/

dzī nā ti/ bi dh+ya ti/ u sha ti/ bi tsa ti/ pṛts+tsha ti/ bṛsh+tsa ti/ bhṛdz+dza ti rnams so/ /yang wa yi dang*/ waṣ+ti ma gtogs pa'i byings de rnams las ya sgra/ 'dis saṃ pra sā ra ṇa/ dzi la de mtha' ring po/ /gnyis brjod nas a bh+yā sa'i cho ga spyi dang*/ khyad par tse krī yi ta la yon tan dang*/ ṛ ldan pa'i rī ā ga ma dang*/ te an bi rnams byas pas/ dza rī gṛ h+ya te/ dze dzī ya te/ be bi dh+ya te/ be bi ts+ya te/ pa rī pṛts+tsh+ya te/ ba rī bṛ+-ish+ts+ya te/ ba rī bhṛ te/ yang dz+yā dang*/ wa yi ma gtogs pa rnams la/ niṣ+ṭha'o zhes pas/ k+ta dang k+ta wan+tu rkyen du byin/ gra hi las iṭa ā ga ma dang*/ de yang ring por btang*/ bya dha la/ gha ḍha ngha bha sogs kyis ta'i dha nghuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas/ byings kyi ngha'i da/ prats+tsha la/ tsha sha dag gi 'ang ngo zhes pas tsha'i ṣa/ ṣa dang ṭa sde las zhes pas ta'i ṭa/ de dang brash+tsi'i tsa ni/ brash+tsi mas+dzi dag gi nghuṭa la'o zhes pas dbyi/ brash+tsi'i ki'ang ngo zhes pas de'i sha yig ka ru bsgyur/ de la niṣ+ṭha'i ta'i na ste/ lū sogs dang ota rjes su 'brel pa las kyang ta na ru bsgyur/ brtsegs pa'i dang po sa ka dag gi mtha' la'ang ngo*/ /zhes pas bh+ras+dzi'i sa dbyi zhing*/ bhṛdza sogs kyi ṣa'o zhes pas/ dza ṣa ru bsgyur/ lhag ma sngar bzhin byas nas/ de rting si byin/ ban+tu'i u rnams brjod don/ an+tu dang as mtha'i zhes pas/ na'i u pa nghā ringapor bsgyur ba sogs byas pas/ gṛ hī taḥ gṛ hī ta wān/ bid nghaḥ bid ngha wān/ pṛṣ+ta/ pṛṣ+ta wān/ bṛk+ṇaḥ bṛk+ṇa wān/ bh-iṣ+taḥ bhṛṣ+ta wān/ dz+yā dang*/ wa sha dang*/ bya tsa rnams la niṣ+ṭha/ 'di'i bya ba bya zhing dang po la de mtha' ring po ta'i na/ phyi ma gnyis la iṭa/ si sngar bzhin/ byas pas/ dzī naḥ dzī na wān/ u shi taḥ u shi ta/ u shi ta wān| bi tsi taḥ bi tsi ta wān/ swa pi zhes pa nyi ṣ+wa pa nyal/ wa tsi zhes pa/ wa tsa brjod/ ya dza lha mchod/ sogs pa ḍu wa pa sa bon 'debs/

wa ha thob pa sogs rnams kyi mthar gnas dbyangs dang bcas pa ni/ yaṇa dang*/ pa ro3k+ṣā dang*| ā shīṣa rnams pha rol la saṃ pra sā ra ṇar 'gyur ba'au/ /de rnams la dngos po dang*/ las dag la te/ yaṇa/ su pya te/ u ts+ya te/ i dz+ya te/ u pya te/ u h+ya te/ pa ro3k+ṣā la/ su ṣu pa tuḥ ū tsa tuḥ ī dza tuḥ ū ya tuḥ ū ha tuḥ a tus la/ a bh+yā sa byas pa'o/ /ā shīṣa'i yāta la su pyā ta/ u ts+yā ta| i dz+yāta/ u pyāta*/ u h+yāta/ byings de rnams la k+ta dang k+ta wan+tu/ ka yig ka la yaṇa bzhin/ zhes sogs kyi don te/ des na yaṇa bzhin du/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa 'gyur bas/ sup+taḥ sup+ta wān/ de bzhin du uk+ta dang*/ iṣ+ta dang*/ up+ta dang*| u ḍha rnams rnam bcad can dang*/ wān mtha' can te/ ya dza'i dza ṣa ru bsgyur ba dang*/ ba ha'i ha'i ḍha dang*/ de mthong bas ta ngha dang*/ ṣa dang ṭa sde zhes pas dha'i ḍha dang*/ ḍha'i ḍha la dbyi zhing dbyangs snga ma'ang ring po'o/ /zhes pa rnams byas pa ste 'og tu'ang de bzhin du dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni bshad ma thag pa'i mdo gnyis ka'i byings rnams kyi a bh+yā sa'i mthar gnas dbyangs dang bcas pa ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā pha rol la saṃ pra sā ra ṇar 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang gra hi/ prats+tshi/ bh+ras+dzi rnams kyi a bh+yā sa ni/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar gyur ma gyur la khyad par med pas gzhan rnams kyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /des na byings gzhan rnams la/ aṭa dang thal/ thal la iṭa ā ga ma/ dz+yā la/ ā yig las aṭa'i au/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge la'ang ngos/ ā dbyi ba rnams byas pas/ dzi dz+yau/ dzi dz+yi tha/ u wa yi| u wa yi tha/ de bzhin du/ bi byā ngha/ u wā sha bi byā tsa/ bṛ brāsh+tsa/ su ṣ+wā pa/ u wā tsa/ i yā dza/ u wā pa/ u wā ha rnams/ aṭa la a'i u pa nghā ring por btang ba sogs yin la/ thal la iṭa dang bcas pas ni/ bi bya nghi tha/ u pa shi tha sogs nas u wa hi tha rnams so/ /bya thi zhes pa bya tha sūl dang 'jigs pa la'o/ /zhes pa 'di'i a bh+yā sa'i mthar gnas dbyangs dang bcas pa'i 'ang*/

pa ro3k+ṣā la/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar 'gyur ro/ /byings de la/ e/ ā te/ i re/ bi bya the| bi bya thā te/ bi bya thi re'o/ / gsum pa ni/ 'o na gong gi ya dza sogs la des khyab bam snyam na/ ma khyab te/ beny snal ma la'o zhes pa'i nya rjes 'brel/ ḍu o shwi 'gro ba la'o// zhes pa 'di gnyis dag gi mthar gnas ni pa ro3k+ṣā yon tan med pa dang*/ 'ang gi sgras a bh+yā sa ni yon tan dang bcas pa la'ang*/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa ma yin no zhes pas mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis la a tus/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i sogs kyis bā ste/ des na dur sing du bā shwi dag gi zhes bshad do/ /gnyis brjod thung ngu*/ byings thams cad pa min pa la ā dbyi ba byas pas/ ba ba tuḥ byings kyi mtha'i zhes sogs byas pas/ shi shwi ya tuḥ yon tan can la/ de gnyis la aṭa/ de'i cho ga sngar bzhin byas pas/ ba bau shi shwā ya swa pi s+ya mi byenya zhes pas/ nyi ṣ+wa pa/ s+ya mu sgra/ byenya sdom/ 'di rnams kyi mthar gnas ni/ tse krī yi ta la der 'gyur ro/ /ya sgra 'di'i bya ba gnyis brjod/ de'i cho ga de mtha' ring*/ te/ an bi/ dbyi/ so su s+ya te/ se si mya te/ be bī ya te/ swa pi tsaṇa la/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar 'gyur te/ nyi ṣ+wa pa/ in/ tsaṇa/ gnyis brjod/ a bh+yā sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa/ su ṣ+wa pa ya/ gra ha nye bar len/ swa pi prats+tshi zhes pa nyi ṣ+wa pa nyal/ prats+tshi shes par 'dod pa rnams kyi mthar gnas ni san pha rol la/ der 'gyur ba'o/ /tum san| 'jigasming pūng ṛ zhes pas iṭa/ 'dis saṃ pra ha'i dha/ byings kyi gsum pa dang po zhes pas/ ga'i gha/ ṣa ḍha dag gi zhes pas/ ḍha'am ka rgyu mtshan las sa'i ṣa/ gnyis brjod/ de'i bya ba byed dgos byas pas/ dzi ghṛk+ṣa ti/ su ṣup+sa ti/ pi pṛts+tshi ṣa ti/ zhar byung ni/ tsā*/ mchod pa dang zhi ba la'o zhes pa'i byings ni/ tse krī yi ta la kī ru 'gyur zhing*/ o s+yā yī 'phel ba la'o zhes pa de ni pa ro3k+ṣā la pī ru 'gyur ba'o/

/byings de gnyis kyi ṛ dang o dang i rnams rjes 'brel/ snga ma la tse krī yi ta'i bya ba thams cad dang/ phyi ma la/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i e byin/ de'i bya ba thams cad bya zhing*/ de la'ang sgras tse krī yi ta'ang byas pas/ tse kī ya te/ pe pī ya te dang/ pi pye/ dper brjod snga ma gnyis la/ te dang*/ phyi ma gnyis la mtshams sbyor byas pa'o/ /shwa ya ti zhes pa/ ḍu o shwi 'phel ba la'o zhes pa 'di'i rkyen de gnyis la saṃ pra sā ra ṇar yang na 'gyur ba'o/ /ya sgra la/ sho shu ya te/ yang na she shwi ya te/ aṭa la/ shu shā wa/ yang na shi shwā ya/ byings de nyid| in kā ri ta pha rol la'ang san tsaṇa dag la/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa yang na 'gyur ba'o/ /de la in/ tum/ san/ 'jigasan la iṭa/ 'di byas shing yon tan rim par byas pas/ shu shā wa yi ṣa ti/ yang na shi shwā ya yi ṣa ti/ hwa ya ti'i ming can/ hwenya'i mthar gnas ni/ kā ri ta dang bcas pa'i san dang tsaṇa pha rol la rtag tu saṃ pra sā ra ṇar 'gyur ba'o/ /hwenya 'gran/ byings las kyang in| tum/ san/ 'jiga'adis saṃ pra/ 'phel ba thob kyang/ gnas can dang 'dra bas hu gnyis brjod/ ha'i dza/ iṭa/ in gyis byings mtha' 'phel ba dang*/ in nyid iṭas yon tan du btang*/ ti an bi/ dzu hā ba yi ṣa ti/ hwe/ in/ di/ aṭa/ 'dis saṃ pra/ 'phel ba/ kā ri ta dbyi in dang tsan la mtshungs pa zhes pas thung ngu*/ hu gnyis brjod/ yang ba'i ring po/ a dzu ha bta/ byings de dang po nas/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar byas na/ de ltar yin mod/ gnyis brjod pa'i/ a bh+yasta'i mthar gnas ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ byings de'i a bh+yasta'i mthar gnas dbyangs bcas kyi yi ge'ang der 'gyur te/ hwenya/ aṭa/ gnyis brjod/ 'dis gnyis ka la a bh+yasta yin pas saṃ pra sā ra ṇa phyi ma 'phel ba/ dzu hā wa/ d+yu ti swa pi zhes pa'i/ d+yu ta gsal/ nyi ṣ+wa pa nyal ba'i byings te/ de dag la a bh+yā sa'i mthar gnas dbyangs dang bcas pa'i saṃ pra sā ra ṇa'o/ /byings dang po la pa ro3k+ṣā'i e/

gnyis brjod/ saṃ pra/ di d+yu te/ byings gnyis pa la in tum san| tum 'jiga.iṭa gnyis brjod/ 'dis snga ma saṃ pra/ in iṭa'i bya ba byas pas/ su ṣ+wā pa yi ṣa ti/ gnyis pa ni/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas zin pa la mthar gnas dbyangs dang bcas pa byung yang*/ slar saṃ pra sā ra ṇa bya ba min no// bya ngha bsnun/ bya tsa zol te/ yaṇa/ gra hi/ dz+yā sogs kyis saṃ pra/ bingha/ bits/ zhes pa'i bi dbyangs bcas ni/ phyogs gcig rnam par 'gyur ba ni gzhan min pa dang 'dra'o zhes pa'i tshig dang*/ mthar gnas pa pha rol gyi dbyangs zhes sogs kyis thob pa ltar snang yang*/ de byas pa'i bya ba la bya ba gnyis pa mi 'jug pas slar saṃ pra sā ra ṇar mi bsgyur te/ bi ngh+ya te/ bi ts+ya te/ de bzhin du/ ba shi zhes pa/ ba sha mdzes pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i ba yang*/ gra hi sogs las thob kyang*/ tse krī yi ta pha rol la/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar mi 'gyur te/ ā ga ma med pa'i ring po sogs la a bh+yā sa'i cho ga byas pas/ bā ba sh+ya te/ de bzhin du gong gi prats+tsha shes par 'dod/ sogs pas o brash+tsu gcod/ bh+ras+dza 'tshed pa rnams kyi/ pa ro3k+ṣā la/ saṃ pra sā ra ṇar mi 'gyur ro/ /de gsum la/ a tus a bh+yā sa'i cho ga dang*/ nghuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas sa'i da/ ta sde'i tsa ṭa'i sogs byas pas/ pa prats+tsha tuḥ ba brash+tsa tuḥ ba bh+radz+dza tuḥ gnyis pa la rnam dbye la brten pa'i byings dang*/ byings la brten pa'i rnam dbye dang*/ slar yang byings kyi rnam 'gyur rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ rnam dbye'i cha shas kyi 'jig tshul bshad pa'o// dang po la mtha' bsgyur ba dang*/ ā ga ma gzhug pa/ mtha' dbyi ba yang bsgyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ e la sogs pa mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge bzhi'i mtha' rnams kyi lus 'gyur ji ltar bya zhe na/ de rnams bi ka ra ṇa min pa'i rkyen pha rol la ā yig ring por bsgyur bar bya'o/ /deng srung*/ des dgado dum bur byed/ shwasta nī'i tā/ 'dis e gnyis dang*/

o ā ru bsgyur bas/ dā dā/ bi ka ra ṇa yin na/ ti/ an bi la/ e a ya dang*/ o a bar bsgyur bas/ da ya ti/ da ba ti/ mdo 'di'i don la khyab pa ma nges te bya tī'i ming can/ byenya sdom pa la'o zhes pa'i byings 'di pa ro3k+ṣā la e ā ru bsgyur ba min pas so/ /de la/ aṭa/ thal| gnyis brjod/ gnyis ka rnams kyi a bh+yā sa'i zhes pas saṃ pra/ byings mtha' aṭa la 'phel ba/ thal la iṭa/ bi byā ya/ bi bya yi tha/ byenya'i dwogs gcod zhar byung du brjod nas/ slar yang dkyus ma 'chad pa ni/ mī nā ti dang*/ mi no ti'i ming can/ mīnya/ 'tshe/ ḍu minya 'phen/ dīng zad/ 'di rnams kyi yon tan dang 'phel ba'i gnas kyi rkyen la mtha' ā nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /de rnams la shwasta nī'i tā/ bha bi ṣ+yan+ti'i s+ya ti dang s+ya te/ bya ba shor ba'i s+yata/ s+ya ta/ 'dis| ā/ mā tā/ mā s+ya ti/ mā s+ya te/ ā mā s+yata/ a mā s+ya ta/ de bzhin du/ dā tā sogs so/ /san pha rol la dīng gi dbyangs ā ru bsgyur te/ dīng zad/ tuṃ saṇa| tuṃ 'jiga'adis dā/ de gnyis brjod/ thung ngu*/ da dā sa ti/ smi zhes pa ṣ+ming tsud rgod/ dzi rgyal/ ḍukrīnya rdzas brje/ ing/ kloga'adi rnams kyi mtha' ni/ in kā ri ta la/ a ā'ang zer nyid du 'gyur zhing*/ dang po dang tha ma la sa ā ga ma dang*/ bar pa gnyis la bi sngon dang*/ tha ma la a nghi sngon/ ti/ an bi/ in yon tan du btang bas/ smā pa ya ti/ bi dzā/ bi krā/ a ngh+yā pa ya ti| de yang spyir btang du/ in dang*/ ti/ an bi la/ smā ya ya ti/ zhes sogs 'thob pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ sṛ dzi dang dṛ sha zhes pa sṛdza spro bar byed/ dṛ shir lta ba/ 'di dag gi dbyangs ṛ yig gnyis las pha rol tu nghuṭa byung ba la yon tan dnga'aphel ba gnas pa'i rkyen la/ a yig ā ga ma 'gyur ba'o/ /de gnyis la/ tā dang*/ s+ya ti dang*/ s+yata 'dis a yig ā ga ma| ṛ yig 'dra ba'i yi ge min pa ra/ bhṛdza sogs rnams kyi ṣa'o/

/tsha sha dag gi 'ong ngo zhes pas dza sha ṣa ru bsgyur/ ṣa dang ṭa sde sogs dang*/ ṣa ḍha dag gi sogs dang*/ praṣ+tā/ prak+ṣ+ya ti/ a prak+ṣ+yata/ draṣ+tā/ drak+ṣ+ya ti/ a drak+ṣ+yata/ 'di'i rkyen la ti sogs kyis ma khyab ste/ sṛ dza/ dṛsha re re la yang wuṇa tṛ tsa'i tṛ tsa dang*/ tum| ta bya rnams byin/ thams cad la dbyangs mthar a yig ā ga ma byas/ tṛtsa'i ts dbyangs don/ rkyen thams cad kṛta kyi rkyen yin pas/ kun la si byin/ tṛ'i ṛ ni/ si la ā ste sogs dang*/ mi zad pa las kyang ngos/ tum las si 'jig pa dang*/ ta bya la/ ma ning gi si mu rnams byin/ sngar bzhin ṣa ṭa bsgyur/ cho ga byas pas/ praṣ+tā/ praṣ+tuṃ/ praṣ+ta byaṃ/ dṛ la'ang de bzhin no/ /gzhan yang spṛsha reg pa/ tṛpa tshim pa/ tṛpa dga' ba sogs la'ang sbyar nas bshad do/ /dīng zad pa la'o zhes pa'i byings kyi mthar ni rkyen dbyangs dang po yon tan med pa la ya yig gi ā ga ma'o/ /de la pa ro3k+ṣā'i e/ ā te/ u pa sngon gnyis brjod| thung ngu*/ u pa di dī ye/ u pa di dī yā te/ gnyis pa ni/ pā btung*/ ḍu dānya sbyin pa sogs byings kyi ā yig rnams ni rkyen dbyangs dang po can yon tan med pa gang zhigabyings thams cad pa min pa pha rol la dbyi bar bya'o/ /de gnyis la a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan dbyangs la gnyis brjod pa byas pa na/ dbyangs kyi cho ga'o zhes pas gnyis brjod/ a bh+yā sa thung ngu*/ 'dis a dbyi/ pa pa tuḥ pa puḥ da da tuḥ thung ngu*/ da duḥ ā yig de ni yon tan dang bcas pa'i iṭa la'ang dbyi bar bya'o/ /pā btung*/ daipa sbyong*/ pa yig ni| dāpa min pa'i dā nghā dag dā'o zhes pa'i don/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i thal/ mtshams sbyor gyi sogs/ gnyis brjod/ thung ngu*/ sṛ bhṛ pṛ bṛ bhṛ sogs kyi nges pa las iṭa ā ga ma/ 'dis ā dbyi/ pa pi tha/ da di tha/ bzhi pa ni/ dā'i ming can rnams dang/ mā tshad/ māng tshad/ meng brdabs pa sogs mā'i ming can rnams dang*|

gā ya ti'i ming can gai sgra/ pi wa ti'i ming can pā btung/ s+thā'i ming can ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba las bzlogas+ya ti'i ming can/ ṣo mtha'i las/ dza hā ti'i ming can o hāka gtong*/ 'di rnams kyi ā yig sogs ni/ rkyen byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa'i gsal byed dang po la/ i yig tu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ḍu dānya sogs/ byings de rnams la/ te yaṇa/ 'dis ī/ dī ya te/ mī ya te/ gī pī| s+thi/ sī/ hī rnams la ya te sbyar ba lta bu'o/ /dā dang mā sogs de rnams ā shī ṣa yon tan med pa dag la e yig tu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /de rnams la ā shī ṣa'i yāta/ de yā ta/ me yāta sogs so/ /si tsa'i mtha' las dang a bh+yasta thob pa las dang/ bid dang*/ ā yig mtha' can rnams las pha rol tu byung ba'i h+yasta nī dang*/ a d+ya ta nī'i pa rasmai'i skyes bu dang po'i an gyi us su bsgyur bar bya ste| bhū yod pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings 'di min pa la ste de la/ an gyi us su mi bsgyur ba'o/ /ḍu kṛnya/ hṛnya/ dṛ shir/ a d+ya ta nī'i an/ de la sitsa/ dbyangs mtha' rnams kyi zhes pas/ sitsa la 'phel ba/ dṛ sha la a yig ā ga ma dang*/ ā'i yang ring po/ gzhan sngar bzhin byas pas/ a kār+ṣuḥ a hār+ṣuḥ a drak+ṣuḥ a bh+yasta las ni/ ghṛ 'gyur bar byed de/ ki dang*/ ki ta shes/ h+yasta nī'i an/ an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jigades na gnyis brjod/ gzhan 'dra/ a bh+yasta rnams kyi us la'os/ yon tan/ 'on kyang kita la yon tan bkag pas/ a dza gha tuḥ a tsi ka yuḥ a tsi ki tuḥ gzhan yang ṛ 'gro/ gnyis brjod pa'i bar snga ma bzhin/ ṛ yig gi a yigapi parti sogs kyis i/ a bh+yā sa'i 'dra ba'i sogs kyis i ya/ an us/ yon tan/ dbyangs dang po rnams kyi dngapo'i 'phel ba'o/ /ai ya ruḥ bid la bid shes/ an/ aṭa/ 'dis/ an/ us/ a bi duḥ bid yod pa dang rnam par dpyod pa min te/ de dag āt+ma ne'i tshig can/ kho na yin par mi srid pas so|

|āta mtha' las/ ṣ+ṇā gtsang*/ shrā 'tshed/ an/ an bi/ ata sogs las 'jiga.aṭa/ ā yig gi u la'o/ /zhes pas/ ā dbyi/ a snuḥ a shruḥ slob phan du/ āta mtha' dang dwiṣa'i pha rol h+yasta nī'i an gyi us/ yang na bshad par bya ste/ da ṛ trā 'gro ba ngan/ pā srung*/ dwiṣa mi dga'/ an/ aṭa an bi/ ata sogs las 'jig yang na an us/ ā yig us la dbyi/ a druḥ a puḥ a dwi ṣuḥ yang na a tran/ a san/ a dwi ṣan/ bhu yin na/ a bhu wan/ zhes pa kho nar nges so/ /gnyis pa la/ ta dang hi dang*/ u dbyi ba'o/ /dang po ni/ a d+ya ta nī'i ta'i cha shas i tsa las rang 'dren gyi ta ni dbyi bar bya'o/ /dper brjod gong du'ang song mod kyi/ bṛ tu 'jugabṛ nghu 'phel| a d+ya ta nī'i at+ma ne'i ta/ dngos po dang las dag la'o zhes pas i tsa| tsa yig mdo 'di'i don/ u pa nghā'i yon tan/ byings kyi dang por aṭa/ 'dis ta dbyi/ a wat+ti/ a war+dha/ des na a d+ya ta nī'i ta phyis pa'i a kā rita las de phan gyi tā rnams byin pa lta bu'i ta ni mi 'phyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ byings a yig can las dang*/ de yang han+ti'i ming can/ han 'tshe ba la'o zhes pa min pa las pha rol gyi pañca mi'i hi yig dbyi'o/ /gaml̥ 'gro| bya ba yang dgar sogs kyi hi/ an bi/ gam i ṣu ya ma rnams kyi tsha'o zhes pas/ ma yig tsha ru bsgyur/ dbyangs las pha rol tsha yig gnyis/ sgra med pa rnams la sogs kyis dang po tsa/ 'dis hi dbyi/ gats+tsha songs shig ces pa'/ོ/ tshur byon cig ces zer na/ de la nyer bsgyur āng sngon du bzhag pas ā gats+tsha/ a yig can min na/ in 'gro ba la/ hi/ an bi/ de 'jigayon tan byas pas/ e hi lta bu'o/ /han+ti yin na/ han+ti'i hi la dza'o/ /zhes pas dza hi/ yi ge gzhan dang brtsegs pa min pa'i nu bi ka ra ṇa las kyang/ pha rol gyi hi dbyi zhing*| de yang bi ka ra ṇa phyis na mi 'gyur bas ma phyis pa las so/ ṣunya mngon par skye/ ṣinya 'ching*/

shinya rno*/ ḍu minya rab tu 'phen/ tsinya sog ḍu dang nya rnams rjes 'brel/ hi*/ su sogs las nu/ 'dis hi dbyi/ su nu/ si nu/ shi nu| mi nu/ tsi nu/ bi ka ra ṇa mi gnas na/ ṇu bstod/ hi/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jig nu hi/ brtsegs pa yin na/ shakl̥ nus/ tak+ṣu phra mor byed/ hi nu| shak+ṣu hi/ tak+ṣ+ṇu hi/ u yig bi ka ra ṇa las kyang*/ pha rol gyi hi yig dbyi'/ོ/ ta nu rgyas/ ṣa nu sby-in/ u gnyis brjod don hi tan sogs las u/ 'dis hi dbyi| ta nu sa nu/ gsum pa ni de lta bu'i u yigabi ka ra ṇa gzhan dang brtseg pa min pa ni/ ba dang ma pha rol dag la yang na dbyi bar bya'o/ /dhunya 'gul| nya dbyangs don/ brta mā na'i bas dang mas/ su sogs las nu 'dis/ dhu n+waḥ dhu nu baḥ dhun+maḥ dhu nu maḥ hi n+waḥ hi nu baḥ hin+maḥ hi nu maḥ 'o na mi la'ang ma yod pas 'gyur ram zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ gcig tshig la yon tan yod pas so/ /des na su no mi/ ka ro mi sogs so/ /brtsegs pa'i bi ka ra ṇa la'ang*| u yig ba ma dag la mi 'phyid de/ ā pl̥ khyab/ bas/ mas/ āp+nu baḥ āp+nu maḥ ka ro ti'i ming can/ ḍu kṛnya byed pa la'o zhes pa'i byings 'di kho na las ni/ pha rol gyi u yig bi ka ra ṇa ste/ ba ma dag la dus rtag tu dbyi bar bya'o/ /de la/ bas/ mas/ ba he/ ma he/ u bi dbyi/ ka ro ti'i'o zhes pas/ byings de nyid rang ngos nas yon tan 'byung bar bshad pas/ kar du bsgyur/ rkyen rnams ni gnyis nyid dang*/ zhes sogs kyis/ gcig tshig min pa la yon tan med pas/ de ma thag tu 'chad 'gyur gyi mdos/ byings kyi a yig u ru bsgyur bas/ kurbaḥ kurmaḥ kurba heḥ kurma he/ ka ro ti de ni sap+ta mī'i ya pha rol la'ang u bi ka ra ṇa 'phyid par bya'o/ /kur+yāta/ kur+yā taṃ/ kur+yuḥ gsum pa la byings kyi dbyangs gsal gyi dang*/ byings ril po'i lus 'gyur bshad pa'/ོ/ dang po la byings thams cad pa la dang*/ aṇa dang*| gsal byed dang po can la dang*|

hi la dang/ pa ro3k+ṣā la dang*/ dbyangs dang po can la dang*/ dbyangs nyid la brten pa'i lus 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i ka ro ti de nyid rkyen byings thams cad pa yin zhing*/ yon tan med pa pha rol la byings kyi a'i u yig nyid du bsgyur bar bshad ma thag pa bzhin bya ste/ kṛ tas/ an+ti/ u bi/ rkyen tas dang*/ in+ti ni gnyis nyid dang*/ mang po nyid dag gi pa rasmai la'o/ /zhes pas yon tan med la/ u bi yang*/ bi ka ra ṇa la an nyid la'/ོ/ zhes pas/ an las gzhan la yon tan med pa yin kyang*/ byings 'di la/ ka ro ti'i 'o zhes pas/ byings nyid la yon tan yod pas ṛ yig ar du bsgyur/ mdo 'dis/ ka'i a u byas nas mtshams sbyar bas/ ku ru taḥ kurban+ti/ de bzhin du/ ā te/ an+te la/ kurbā te/ kurbān+te/ kurba te/ a yig ma yin pa la/ āt+ma nela'ang ngo zhes pas/ an+ti'i na phyis pa'o/ /byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa la/ ru nghir sgrib/ bhi dir rnam par 'joms pa lta bu/ ru ngha sogs kyi bi ka ra ṇa'i mtha' dbyi zhing*/ asti'i m-ing can a sa yod pa la'o zhes pa'i dang po'i dbyangs dbyi'o/ /byings de gsum las tas/ an+ti/ snga ma gnyis la/ ru ngha sogs kyi dbyangs las pha rol tu na sgra dang*/ de'i mtha'i dbyangs phyis/ gha ḍha dha bha sogs kyis/ ta'i ngha dang*/ nghu ṭa rnams kyi bzhi pa rnams la sogs pa byas pas/ ru ཿ ru n+ti/ bhiḥ bhin+dan+ti/ byings gsum pa la/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jig 'dis dang po dbyi bas/ staḥ san+ti/ byings thams cad pa dbyangs dang po can yon tan med pa la ni/ a bh+yasta rnams kyi mtha'i ā yig dang*| ḍu krī&/ rdzas brje ba sogs rnams kyi/ bi ka ra ṇa'i mtha'i a yig dbyi bar bya'o/ /ḍu dānya sbyin/ o hāka gtong*/ dā dang hā las gzhan rjes 'brel/ an+ti/ ā bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jigades na gnyis brjod/ a bh+yā sa'i bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ a bh+yasta las an+ti'i na dbyi/ 'dis mtha'i a dbyi/

da da ti/ dza ha ti/ krī las/ an+ti/ nā bi/ 'dis a dbyi/ krī ṇan+ti/ a bh+yasta dang*/ krī sogs gnyis ka rnams kyi nang nas/ byings dā'i ming can rnams min pa thams cad ni/ byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa'i gsal byed dang po pha rol la/ ā yig de dag ī yig tu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /māng/ 'jal/ o hāng 'gro/ te/ se ngh+we/ an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jig pa gnyis brjod/ bhṛnya hāng māng sogs kyis i/ 'dis ī/ mi mī te/ mi mī ṣe/ mi mī dh+we/ dzi hī te/ dzi hī ṣe/ dzi hī ngh+we/ krī la/ rkyen de gsum/ nā bi ka ra ṇa/ 'dis nā'i ā ī krī ṇi te sogs so| |byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa'i gsal byed dang po pha rol la/ da ri trā ti'i ming can/ da ri trā zhes pa'i rtags 'di'i ā yig ni/ i thung ngur bsgyur te/ de la/ tas/ bas/ mas/ da ri tri taḥ da ri dri baḥ da ri dri maḥ o hāka'i lus 'gyur/ dza hā ti'i ming can/ dza hā zhes pa 'di'i ā yig ni| sap+ta mī la/ dbyi bar bya bas dza hā/ yāta/ dza h+yāta/ han+ti'i m-ingacan/ ha na 'tshe ba'i mtha' ni/ byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa/ nghuṭa dang po can la dbyi bar bya'o/ /ha na 'tshe/ tas/ thas/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jiga'adis na dbyi bas ha taḥ ha thaḥ gnyis pa ni/ sha sa'i ming can shā su rjes su ston pa la'o zhes pa 'di'i u pa nghā ni/ puṣa sogs kyi skabs kyi aṇa dang*| gsal byed po'i rkyen yon tan med pa dag la/ ita ces pa/ i thung ngur 'gyur ro/ /de la/ di/ tām/ si/ aṭa/ pu ṣa sogs kyis aṇa/ 'dis u pa nghā'i i/ shā si ba si gha si rnams kyi'ang zhes pas/ sa'i ṣa/ a shi ṣata/ a shi ṣa tām/ gsal byed la/ te/ yaṇa/ shi ṣ+ya te/ gsum pa ni/ han+ti'i ming can ha na 'tshe ba ni/ hi pha rol la ha na ril po dza yig tu bsgyur/ hi la an bi byas pa 'jig pas/ dza dbyangs bcas su bshad de brtag par bya'o/ /grub 'bras ni| dza hi hi pha rol la/ dā'i ming can dang*/

asti'i ming can a sa yod pa'i mtha' ni e ru 'gyur te/ snga ma la a bh+yā sa dbyi ba dang*/ phyi ma la asti'i dang po dbyi ba byas pas/ de hi/ e nghi zhes pa ste/ snga ma la dzu ho ti sogs las/ an bi| 'jig pa dang*/ gnyis brjod pa byas shing*/ phyi ma la asti las so zhes pas| hi'i nghi byas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ brtsegs pa'i sgo nas grogs med pa'i gsal byed gcig pu pa'i dbus sam nang na yod pa'i a yig ni pa ro3k+ṣā yon tan med pa la e yig tu bsgyur zhing*/ de yang dang po a bh+yā sa'i gsal byed ma bsgyur ba dbyi bas byas pa yin na'au/ /pa tsa 'tshed/ da mu zhi/ a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod/ a bh+yā sa dbyi/ 'dis a e/ pe tsa tuḥ pe tsuḥ de ma tuḥ de muḥ pa ro3k+ṣā la iṭa sogs kyis bar du chod na snga mar mi 'gyur snyam pa'i dwogs pa bcad pa ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i thal la'ang iṭa ā ga ma byung ba de dang bcas pa la'ang*/ mdo snga ma'i cho ga 'gyur te pa tsa/ thal/ kṛ sṛ bṛ sogs kyis iṭa/ la rjes 'brel/ pe tsi tha/ sha kl̥ nus pa la/ she ki tha/ pa ro3k+ṣā yon tan med pa spyi dang*/ thal iṭa dang bcas pa la/ tṝ rkyal/ pha la rdzogs/ bha dzā bsten/ tra pu ṣa ngo tsha/ shran+thi gran+thi gzhung sgrigadan+bhi zhes pa/ dan+bhu tshul 'chos pa rnams kyi'ang*/ a yig e dang*/ a bh+yā sa dbyi'o/ /tra puṣa'i/ uṣa dang phal man chod kyi dbyings mtha' rjes 'brel/ a tus/ us/ thal/ de la iṭa/ tṛ la ṛta mtha' zhes pas yon tan/ te ra tuḥ te tuḥ ti ri tha/ de bzhin du/ phe la tuḥ bhe dza tuḥ tre pa tuḥ shre tha tuḥ gre tha tuḥ de bha tuḥ phyi ma gsum gyi a nu ṣaṃ ga phyis pa'o/ /'o na rkyen mtshan nyid de rnams tshang ba la cho ga des khyab bam zhe na/ min te/ sha su 'tshe lta bu shas dang*/ dā sbyin pa lta bu dang*/ ḍu ba ma skyug pa lta bu/ ba dang po can dang*/ shṝ 'tshe/ pṝ skyong lta bu'i byings yon tan can rnams kyi pha rol tu rkyen de lta bu byung yang*/

a yig e dang*/ a bh+yā sa dbyi bar bya ba min pas so/ /de rnams la/ a tus/ thal/ iṭa/ gnyis brjod sogs byas pas/ sha sha sa tuḥ sha sha si tha/ da da da tuḥ da da di tha| ba ba ma tuḥ ba ba mi tha/ shṝ sṝ dag gi ṛta mtha'i yon tan sha sha ra tuḥ sogs dang*/ pa pa ra tuḥ sogs so/ /lnga pa la dbyangs dang po can spyir btang*/ bye brag pa la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni byings kyi mtha'i i'i yi ge dang u'i yi ge dag ni/ rkyen dbyangs dang po can yon tan med pa pha rol la rim pa bzhin/ i ya dang u ba tu bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ika dran/ ka rjes 'brel/ bī rab tu skye/ brū& gsal bar brjod/ a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod sogs/ ī ya tuḥ ī yuḥ bi bi ya tuḥ su su ba tuḥ bu bru ba tuḥ sogs so/ /a bh+yā sa'i i yig dang u yig ni/ 'dra ba'i yi ge min pa la de gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /ṛ 'gro/ ti| yāta/ tu/ an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jig pa dang*/ gnyis brjod/ ṛ yig gi a art-i+-i+i pi parti zhes pas i/ 'dis i ya/ sap+ta mī la yon tan med/ i yarti/ i yāta/ i yartuḥ dbyangs dang po yon tan med pa la/ bi ka ra ṇa'i ṇu'i u yig u ba ru bsgyur te/ āpl̥/ shakl̥/ an+ti/ an+tu/ nu bi/ 'dis u ba/ ā snu ban+ti/ āsnu ban+tu/ sha ban+ti sogs so/ /rkyen de la snga ma brtsegs pa min zhing*/ yi ge gcig min pa'i i'i yi ge ni ya ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /byings kyi mtha'i i'i yi ge sogs kyi dmigs bsal lo/ /tsinya sogaṇīnya thob/ a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod/ tsi ts+ya tuḥ tsi ts+yuḥ ni n+ya tuḥ ni n+yuḥ rkyen de la/ iṇa 'gro ba'i byings kyi i yang ya ru bsgyur ro/ /an+ti/ an+tu/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigayan+ti/ yan+tu zhes pa'o/ /snga ma brtsegs pa min pas bi ka ra ṇa'i nu'i u yig ni/ dbyangs dang po yon tan med pa la wa ru 'gyur ro/ ṣunya skye/ tsiny soga.an+ti nu su n+wan+ti/ tsi n+wan+ti/ gnyis pa la dbyangs dang po la dang*/

de dang 'dra ba'i ya la brten pa'o/ /dang po la byings thams cad pa'i dang*/ pa ro3k+ṣā sogs gnyis kyi dang*/ kā ri ta'i dbyangs la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni hu sbyin pa'i lus 'gyur/ dzu ho ti'i ming can/ dzu hu zhes pa'i u ni byings thams cad pa'i dbyangs dang po yon tan med pa la war 'gyur ro/ /hū sbyin/ in+ti/ an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jigaganyis brjod sogs/ dzu hwa ti/ gnyis pa ni bhū yod pa la'o/ /zhes pa 'di'i mtha' pa ro3k+ṣā dang a d+ya ta nī dag gi dbyangs dang po can la wa yig ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /bhū yod/ aṭa/ a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod sogs/ bha wa ti'i a| ba bhū wa/ ba bhū wa tuḥ ba bhū buḥ 'o na gal te phyogs gcig rnam pa 'gyur ba ni gzhan min pa dang 'dra'o/ /zhes pa'i tshig las ba yig gis chod kyang aṭa la 'phel bar 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan la'ang u pa dha sogs su 'gyur ro// zhes na/ ā ga ma dang bsgyur ba dag las ā ga ma'i sgrub pa stobs dang ldan no zhes pa'i tshig las de thams cad ba yig gis khegs so/ a d+ya ta nī'i an/ a bhū wan/ zhar byung ni/ go hi zhes pa gu hū kun nas sgrib pa la'o zhes pa 'di'i u dhā ūta nyid du 'gyur te/ de'i byings mtha' rjes 'brel/ ti tas/ an+ti/ an bi/ yon tan/ 'dis o'i ū/ gū ha ti/ gū ha taḥ gū han+ti/ gsum pa ni| du ṣa rnam 'gyur nyid la'o/ /zhes pa 'di'i u pa dhā ni/ kā ri ta pha rol la ū nyid du 'gyur te/ in ti/ an bi/ yon tan/ dū ṣa ya ti/ 'dir slob phan las/ byings 'di sems chags pa dang bral ba la 'jug bzhin pa la/ kā ri ta la'ang*/ 'di'i u pa dha ū nyid du yang na 'gyur/ tsit+taṃ dū ṣa ya ti/ yang na tsit+taṃ do ṣa ya ti/ zhes bshad do/ /ghaṭā byed pa la'o/ /zhes pa nas ṣam dang*/ ṣ+tam rnam par 'khrul pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi byings rnams ni/ ma rjes 'brel dngos su med kyang*/ bya ba'i don la sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis/

ma rjes su 'brel ba bshad pas/ de rnams kyi u pa dhā ni/ kā ri ta pha rol la thung ngur 'gyur ra/ོ/ gha ṭa byed/ bya tha sūl/ pra tha rab tu bshad/ in/ de la spyir a'i u pa dha ring por thob kyang*/ 'dis thung ngu*/ ti an bi/ yon tan/ ghaṭa ya ti/ bya tha yu ti/ pra tha ya ti/ slob phan du ni/ ghaṭa sogs na med pa'i ra mu dang*/ bh+ra mu sogs kyang*| ma rjes su 'brel bar bshad do/ /de bzhin du/ rañja tshos zhes pa 'di/ ri dwags rtse ba'i don la ma rjes 'brel dang*/ smṛ tshig 'don zhes pa/ 'di lhag par klog pa dang*/ tri 'jig ces pa 'di/ 'jig pa la sbyor ba'i don rnams la/ ma rjes 'brel du bshad do/ ma rjes 'brel de rnams kā ri ta la ni/ u pa dhā thung ngur nges la/ a d+ya ta nī'i ta'i cha shas i tsa pha rol la der yang na 'gyur bas a gha ṭi/ a ghā ṭi sogs so/ /dza na ba dhi zhes pa/ dza na skye/ ha na 'tshe ba/ a d+ya ta nī la ba dhi ru bsgyur ba 'di dag gi i tsa li/ u pa dhā thung ngur 'gyur te/ de yang yang na log pas nges par 'gyur ro/ /a dza ni/ a ba dhi zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ ota ces pa o ke sha med pa dang*/ auta ces pa de yod pa dag las| pha rol gyi ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa la yin dang byed pa po la ā yi zhes pa dag ni dbyangs bzhin du 'gyur bas/ i ya u wa sogs dbyangs kyi cho ga rnams bya'o/ /gaml̥ 'gro ga mi las ḍau'o zhes dang*/ ṇud ded/ glā nu di dag las ḍau'o zhes pa'i kṛta kyi rkyen gnyis byings de gnyis la byin/ ḍa rjes su 'brel ba las mtha'i dbyangs la sogs pa phyis pas/ go nau/ de gnyis ka la yin ā yi/ in dang i brjod don/ nā mi dang gsal byed mtha' las/ ā yi'i ā yang phyis pas/ gnyis ka la y srog med re lus shing*/ snga ma la ti dang*| phyi ma la te/ an bi/ o a ba dang*/ au ā wa byas pas/ ga bya ti/ ga bya te/ nā bya ti/ nā bya te/ 'di ni yin dang*/

ā yi'i ngos nas/ dbyangs bzhin du 'gyur ba kho na min gyi/ ota dang auta kyi ngos nas kyang yin te/ rā len pa la| rā ti las ḍai'o byas pa'i re re la de gnyis byung na/ rai ya ti/ rai ya te/ zhes 'gyur bas so/ 'o na ā yi la dbyangs bzhin 'gyur zhes brjod pa mi rigs te/ dbyangs nyid yin pas so zhe na/ bden mod kyang*/ de phyis pa na/ sgrub pa thams cad la dbyi ba'i sgrub pa stobs dang ldan no zhes/ a ya nyid la dbyangs 'dra byas pa'o/ /byings nā mi'i mtha' rnams kyi ni yaṇa bi ka ra ṇa dang*/ ā yi dang*/ yin dang*/ ā shī ṣa dang*/ tse krī yi ta'i ya te/ ya yig pha rol la ring por 'gyur te/ yaṇa la/ dzi rgyal/ shru thos/ te yaṇa/ dzī ya te/ shrū ya te/ ā yi la bhū yod/ ūrmi sogs las mi/ phrad las yon tan med/ byed pa po la ā yi/ nā mi dang gsal byed mtha' las ā dbyi ste/ an bi/ bhū mi ya te/ yin la/ ag+ni dang*/ pa ṭu la/ yin ti/ an bi/ ag+nī ya ti/ pa ṭū ya ti/ ā shī ṣa la/ dzi rgyal/ dh+ru brtan/ yāta/ dzā+-i yata/ dh+rū yāta/ tse krī yi ta la/ tsinya sogaya sgra 'dis ring*/ gnyis brjod thung ngu*/ tse krī yi ta la yon tan te/ an bi/ tse tsī ya te/ de bzhin du/ ṣ+tu bstod pa la/ toṣ+t+rū ya te/ byings kyi gong na nyer bsgyur med pa'i/ iṇa 'gro ba'i dbyangs ni/ ā shī ṣa'i ya la ring por 'gyur ra

ོ | |ī yāta/ ī yastāṃ/ yaṇa ni/ mngon par brjod pa med pa dang*/ gzhan gsum ni byings nyid yin pas/ 'dir rjes su mi 'jug go /drug pa ni/ ṛta kyi mtha' can gyi byings dang ming las/ tswi dang tse krī yi ta dang*/ yin dang*/ ā yi rnams pha rol la/ ī yig ā ga ma mthar 'gyur ro/ /shutsa mya ngan/ shukla taṇ+ḍu la rnams so/ /zhes pas tshig phrad las/ a la'i rkyen dang*/ tsa'i ka ru bsgyur| shukla/ tsan+d+ra par/ ma byung ba la de byung ba la/ kṛ bhu asti ldan pa la rnam 'gyur las tswi'o/ /zhes pas de'i mthar tswi/ 'dis shukla'i mthar ī yig ā ga ma| i'i yi ge dang zhes sogs kyis rtags mtha'i a dbyi/ nyer spyod las tswi phyis pas/ shuklī kṛnya/ hṛnya/ ya sgra/ gnyis brjod sogs spyi dgos byas pas/ tse krī ya te/ dze hrī ya te/ mā tṛ dang*/ pi tṛ la/ rim bzhin yin dang*/ ā yi/ de gnyis kyi cho ga sngar bzhin byas pas/ mā trī ya ti/ pi trī ya ti/ ṛta ces pas/ ṝ ring po lta bu 'gog pa ste/ kṝ rnam par g.yeng ba la ya sgra byas na/ tse kīr+ya te/ ṛta mtha'i yon tan med pa la sogs dang*/ nā mi'i ra ba sogs byas pa'/ོ/ ṛta mtha'i de nyid an bi ka ra ṇa yon tan med pa pha rol la i thung ngu*/ ā ga ma 'gyur te/ tṛng ma gus/ dhṛng kun tu gnas te/ an bi/ tuta sogs las yon tan med/ 'dis is/ dbyangs la i ya byas pas dri ya te/ dh+ri ya te/ ṛta/ mtha' de nyid/ yaṇa bi dang*/ ā shī ṣa dag la ya pha rol la i thung ngu*/ ā ga mar 'gyur ro/ /nā mi mtha' zhes sogs kyis/ ring po thob pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /kṛnya te/ yaṇa bi/ hṛnya yāta/ kri ya te hri yāta/ skyon de gnyis pha rol la arti'i ming can ṛ 'gro ba dang*/ smṛ sems pa lta bu/ brtsegs pa dang po dag gi ṛ yig ni/ yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis la te yaṇa yāte/ ar ya te| ar yāta/ smar+ya te/ smar+yāta/ brtsegs pa dang po la 'dir yon tan du 'gyur na/

ḍu kṛnya byed pa la saṃ sngon/ saṃ pa ri rgyan las suṭa ā ga ma/ uṭa rjes 'brel/ saṃ skṛ zhes gnas pa na/ dang po brtsegs pa yin pas/ rkyen 'di gnyis la yon tan du 'gyur ro zhe na/ nang gi yan lag la phyi'i yan lag grub pa min no/ /zhes pa'i tshig las der mi 'gyur te/ saṃ skṛ ya te/ saṃ skṛ yāta/ ces so/ /arti dang brtsegs pa dang po'i ṛ yig ni/ rkyen snga ma gnyis su ma zad de/ tse kri yi ta la'ang yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /byings de gnyis la ya sgra gnyis brjod/ de yang dang po la gnyis pa'i'o zhes pas r+ya gnyis brjod/ a bh+ya sa'i cho ga lhag ma spyi dang*/ ā ga ma med pa'i ring po byas pas/ rā r+ya te/ sā smar+ya te/ te an bi byas pa'o/ /rkyen de la gh+rā dri len pa dang*/ dh+mā sgra dang*/ me kun tu sbyor ba la'o/ /zhes pa 'di dag gi mtha'i ā ni/ ī ru bsgyur bas/ dze gh+ri ya te/ de dh+mi ya te/ ming las bdag nyid 'dod pa'i don can gyi yin pha rol la| rtags mtha'i a yig gi i nyid du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ma gi 'gro ba'i don la| i dita kyi num/ mang gi las/ a la tsa zhes pa'i rkyen tsa dbyangs don/ mang ga la/ zhes gnas pa la/ yin ti/ an ti/ an bi rnams byas/ mang ga lī ya ti/ gnyis pa ni rkyen gyi dbang gis byings kyi dbyangs gsal mtha' dag lus 'gyur ba ste/ de yang a di zhes pa a da za ba la'o zhes pa 'di'i san dang*/ a d+ya ta nī pha rol dag la/ byings ril po ghasl̥ zhes par 'gyur zhing*/ l̥ yig ni puṣa zhes pa'i rtags don no/ /dpe a da za/ tum san 'jigaganyis brjod sogs spyi dang*/ san la a yig gi'o/ /sa'i sa la ta'o rnams byas pas/ dzi ghat+pa ti/ a da za/ di tām/ an/ dang por aṭa/ ghasl̥/ puṣa sogs kyi aṇa/ a gha sata/ a gha sa tām/ a gha san/ byings de pa ro3k+ṣā la yang na ghasl̥r 'gyur ro/ /de la aṭa/ a tus/ us/ aṭa la a'i u pa dhā ring po/ gzhan gnyis la/ gaṃ han/

zhes pas u pa dhā phyis/ sgra med pa rnams la zhes pas| gha'i ka shā si ba si zhes pas sa ṣa ru bsgyur zhing*/ pa ro3k+ṣā la gnyis brjod pa'i cho ga rnams byas pas/ dza ghā sa/ dzak+ṣa tuḥ dzak+ṣuḥ yang na ā da| ā da tuḥ ā duḥ pa ro3k+ṣā la benya snal ma'i rgyud la'o zhes pa'i byings 'di wa yi zhes par yang na 'gyur zhing*/ i ni brjod don/ de la/ aṭa/ a tus| us/ wa ya/ aṭa la gnyis ka rnams kyi a bh+yā sa'i pa ro3k+ṣā la'os/ wa ya gnyis brjod pa'i/ a bh+ya sa saṃ pra sā ra ṇa dang*/ gzhan gnyis la a bh+yā sa dang*/ a bh+yasta gnyis ka saṃ pra sā ra ṇa byas pas/ u wā ya/ ū ya tuḥ ū yuḥ yang na ba yi ru ma bsgyur bar mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i mtha' sogs byas pas/ ba bau/ ba ba tuḥ ba buḥ wa yi'i ya yig pa ro3k+ṣā/ yon tan med pa la ba yig tu yang na bsgyur bar slob phan gyis bshad pas/ ū ba tuḥ ū buḥ han+ti'i ming can ha na 'tshe ba'i byings 'di/ ā shī ṣa pha rol la ba dhi zhes par 'gyur zhing*/ i brjod don/ de la yāta/ ba dh+y-ita/ byings de lus 'gyur der 'gyur ba ni rkyen der ma zad/ a d+ya ta nī la yang ngo*/ /han de tam an 'dis ba dhi/ dang por aṭa/ si tsa/ gcig tshig la si tsa las īṭa dang*/ des si tsa dbya| gzhan gnyis las si tsa'i gong du iṭa ā ga ma/ sitsa la an gyi us/ a ba dhīta/ a ba dhiṣ+tāṃ/ a ba dhi ṣuḥ rkyen 'di'i āt+ma ne la/ byings 'di'i lus 'gyur yang na bar slob phan no/ /rkyen de la iṇa 'gro ba'i byings ni gā zhes par 'gyur bas iṇa/ di tam an aṭa sitsa iṇa s+thā sogs kyis/ sitsa 'jig pa dang*/ an gyi us dang*/ de la a yig dbyi ba rnams byas pas/ a gāta/ a gā tā ma/ a guḥ ing*/ klog pa zhes bya ba'i byings kyi ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā pha rol ma gā ru bsgyur/ de la aṭa pa ro3k+ṣā'i bya ba spyi dgos byas pas/ dza gau e ā te la/ dza ge /dza gā te/ byings de la a d+ya ta nī dang*/

bya ba shor ba la gī ru bsgyur bar bshad do/ /san pha rol la in dang*/ inga'i byings de gnyis dag gi ga mi ru bsgyur zhing i brjod don/ in ing tuṃ/ san 'jiga'adis gam/ gnyis brjod sogs/ ti an bi gaṃ las pa rasmai la'o zhes pas/ san gyi gong du iṭa/ dzi ga mi ṣa ti/ te byin na han dang ing gi gaṃ dag gi u pa dhā'i 'o zhes pas u pa dhā ring po dang*/ iṭa med pa byas pas gāṃ sa te/ a sti'i ming can/ as yod pa'i byings 'di ni/ rkyen byings thams cad pa min pa/ thams cad la bhū zhes pa 'dir bsgyur par bya'o/ /de la 'byung 'gyur la zhes sogs kyis/ pya ti dang*/ yāta dang tā'o/ byings thams cad pa min pa gsal byed dang po ya yig dang po min pa'i dang por iṭa ā ga ma'o/ /zhes yāta las gzhan la iṭa/ de la yon tan yod pas bha bi ṣ+ya ti/ bhū yāta/ bha bi tā/ gzhan yang byings thams cad pa min pa la brūnya gsal bar smra ba la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings ni ba tsi zhes pa dang*/ tsak+ṣing gsal bar brjod pa ces pa 'di ni khyānya zhes par 'gyur zhing rtsa ba'i byings kyi ing nya dang bsgyur ba'i byings kyi inya brjod don/ byings de gnyis la shwasta nī'i tra dang*/ bha bi ṣ+yat+na'i s+ya ti/ snga ma la tsa ka ru bsgyur ba dang*/ phyi ma la nyer bsgyur āng sngon du byas pas/ wak+tā wak+ṣ+ya ti| ā khyā tā/ ā khyā s+ya ti/ mdo phyi ma'i bya ba 'di ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā la yang na bar 'gyur bas/ de'i e/ ā te/ i re la/ ā tsa khyā+e/ ā tsa khyā te/ ā tsa khyi te/ khyā'i ā yig ni byings thams cad pa min pa la phyis pa'o/ /yang na ā tsa tsak+ṣe sogs so/ /pa ro3k+ṣā la yang na'o zhes pa glo bur ba yin pas/ byings thams cad pa min pa la a dzi zhes pas/ a dza 'gro ba dang 'phen pa'i byingasas ni bī ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /tā/ s+ya ti/ be tā/ bi ṣ+ya ti/ yon tan byas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni| a dang s+sa za sogs ṣ+wa pa nyal/ ba sha mdzes/

ha na 'tshe ba sogs 'di rnams la pha rol gyi bi ka ra ṇa ni 'jig par 'gyur zhing*/ de yanga'agrel ṭīka gi 'bru snon dang*/ dper brjod rnams su/ an bi ka ra ṇa nyid bshad mod kyi gzhan la'ang mtshon pa ste/ slob phan gyi mtha' gzhan 'gog pa'i dper brjod du bi ka ra ṇa zhes pas yaṇa gcod par bshad kyi/ u sogs rnams ma bshad pas so/ /'o na yaṇa yang bi ka ra ṇar 'dod pa min nam zhe na/ spyir 'dod kyang 'dir bstan du mi 'dod pas skyon med do/ /byings de rnams la ti/ yāta/ tu/ di| tha ma la dang por aṭa/ kun la/ an bi de/ 'dis 'jiga.at+ti/ p+sa ti| swa s+yāta/ wastu/ a han tha ma la brtsegs pa'i mtha' phyis pa'o/ /mtshams 'dir slob phan du/ dzu ho ti sogs kyi 'ang ngo*/ /tse krī yi ta'i yang na'o zhes pa'i mdo gnyis 'byung ba'i don ni/ hu sbyin/ sogs pas/ nyi bhī 'jigs/ hrī ngo tsha/ ti| an bi/ 'dis 'jigades na byings gnyis brjod sogs dang yon tan byas pas/ dzu ho ti/ bi bhe ti/ dzi hre ti/ tse krī yi ta'i ming can gyi ya sgra yang na 'jig par 'gyur te/ bhū yod/ ra ṭa bshad ya sgra/ gnyis brjod sogs spyi dgos kyi cho ga byas shing*/ bshad pa las īṭa byas pas/ bo bha bī ti/ rā ra ṭī ti| yang na bo bhū ya te/ rā ra ṭ+ya te zhes so/ /iṇa 'gro/ s+thā gnas/ dā'i ming can dang pi ba ti zhes pa la pā btung*/ bhū yod/ ces pa 'di rnams las pha rol gyi si tsa ni/ rang 'dren byed dgu tshan gnyis las pa rasmai la dbyi bar bya'o/ /de rnams la/ de sitsa/ de 'dis 'jig cing*/ iṇa'i gā/ a gāta/ a s+thāta/ a dāta/ a pāta/ a bhūta/ 'dis slob phan du/ gh+rā shā ts+tshā sā ngheṭa rnams kyi sitsa 'ang pa rasmai la yang na 'jig par bshad de/ gh+rā dri len/ sho phra mor byed/ ts+tsho gcod/ ṣo mtha'i las/ ngheṭa btung*/ di sitsa/ 'dis 'jiga.a gh+rāta/ a shāta/ ats+tshāta/ a pāta/ a nghāta phyogs gcig la/ sitsa las/ īṭa byas pas/

a gh+rī pīta/ pa rasmai zhes pa'i rnam bcad āt+ma ne la/ der mi 'gyur ba ni/ shugs la rtogs la/ grub 'bras ji lta bu 'byung ba ni/ gong 'og bsgrigs nas brtag na shes par nus pas/ ma bshad pa ni gzhung mangs su dwogs pas kyang yin te/ rgyas par slob phan 'grel bshad dang bcas par ston pas/ spro na de dag tu blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa kun bshad rkang pa bzhi pa'i rnam par bshad pa rdzogs so// //lnga pa la yang yon tan dngos kyi rnam gzhag dang*/ zhar byung rnam 'gyur gzhan bshad pa'o/ /dang po la spyir btang mdor bstan/ dmigs bsal rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tṝ rkyal/ tsi3 sogaṇī& thob ṣ+tu3 bstod/ lū& gcod pa la'o/ /zhes sogs/ nā mi mtha'i byings thams cad/ yon tan ma bkag pa'i rkyen pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur zhing*/ byings ma yin kyang*/ bi ka ra ṇa dag gi yang de bzhin du yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /de yang byings kyi yon tan ni| byings dang po la brta mā na'i ti dang an bi/ gzhan rnams la shwasta nī'i tā/ byings mtha'i nā mi ṛ yig gi ar dang*/ i yig ring thung gi e dang*/ u yig ring thung gi o ru 'gyur te/ yon tan gyi bsgyur bya bsgyur 'bras gang nas 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pas so/ /de ltar na/ ta ra ti/ tse tā/ ne tā/ sto tā/ lo tā/ 'di la iṭa byin na/ la bi tā/ byings bzhi pa la byings kyi dang po ṣa'i sa'o dang*/ rgyu mtshan med na rgyu mtshan can yang med do byas pa'o/ /bi ka ra ṇa la ni ṣu3 mngon par skye/ ti/ su sogs las nu/ mdo 'dis nu'i u yig gi yon tan or bsgyur bas/ su no ti/ 'o na byings yon tan du bsgyur ba la nā mi mtha' can kho na dgos sam zhe na/ u pa nghā nā min gyi yang 'gyur te/ de yang*/ ring cha sogs kyi lji ba min par/ yang ba yin pa'i dbang du bya'o/ /bid shes/ mu ṣa dga'/ bṛ tu 'jugatā/ iṭa 'dis yon tan/ be di tā/ mo ṣi tā/ ba di tā/

'o na ti yin par mtshungs shing*/ bi ka ra ṇa yod par mtshungs pa la/ an gyis byings mtha' yon tan du sgyur nus la/ nu yig gis mi nus pa ci zhe na/ da lta nyid du/ bi ka ra ṇa la/ an nyid la'o/ /zhes pas bi ka ra ṇa du ma yod pa'i nang nas an nyid la yon tan yod la/ gzhan la med ces pas/ an gyi yon tan mi 'gog cing*/ gzhan gyis 'gog pas so/ /des na dper brjod gong ma bzhin dang*/ gzhan yang*/ bhū yod/ ti/ an bi/ bha ba ti/ gnyis pa la thob pa la sgrub pa dang*/ mi thob pa la dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rkyen yon tan med pa la| nā mi mtha'i byings yon tan du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ byings sogs rang ngos nas yon tan du 'gyur ba yod de/ ka ro ti'i ming can du/ ḍukṛnya byed pa la'o zhes sogs 'di ni ti sogs kyi rkyen yon tan yod med kun la/ rang nyid ṛ yig gi yon tan ar du 'gyur ro/ /yon tan yod pa la kṛ ti/ u bi/ bi ka ra ṇa yang*/ yon tan byas pas ka ro ti/ yon tan med pa la kṛ/ h+ya sta nī'i ta/ kartā/ de bzhin du/ tas an+ti/ u bi/ byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa la a'i u yig go zhes pa dang bcas pas ku ru taḥ kurban+ti/ ka ro ti zhes smos pa ni/ kṝ& 'tshe ba la'o zhes sogs/ ḍukṛnya byed pa las gzhan pa'i kṛ rnams bzlog pa'i don du bshad pas/ 'di ni byings khyad par ba'i bya ba la'o/ /kṝnya 'tshe ba la ni/ ti/ nu/ bi/ kṝ ṇo ti/ de bzhin du/ mi di'i 'o zhes pa la/ bhū sogs kyi mi di ni yon tan can du grub pas/ nyi mi dā snum pa la'o/ /zhes pa dis sogs kyi nang na yod pa/ 'di la dis sogs las yon zhes pa'i yan la yon tan yod par bsgrub pa ste/ 'di ni an nyid la'o zhes pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /me d+ya ti zhes so/ /a bh+yasta rnams kyi nā mi'i sitsa a bh+yasta/ bid/ āta rnams las bhū min pa las an gyi us so zhes pa'i h+yasta nī dang*/ a d+ya ta nī'i mang tshig an/

us su bsgyur ba'i us la yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /'di ni 'og nas gnyis nyid dang mang po nyid dag la yon tan bkag pas/ rkyen la/ yon tan med kyang byings rang ngos nas yon tan byas pa'o/ /hu sbyin/ nyi bhī 'jigadzā gṛ gnyid sad/ h+yasta nī'i an an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs las 'jigaganyis brjod/ sitsa sogs kyis an us/ 'dis/ yon tan/ a dzu ha buḥ a bi bh+ra yuḥ 'di yang sngar bshad pa lta bu'i us la 'gyur gyi/ rnam dbye'i u gang yin la mi 'gyur te/ tsinya sogapa ro3k+ṣā'i us/ snga ma brtsegs pa min pa sogs kyis/ i ya ru bsgyur bas tsi ts+yuḥ gnyis pa la ṇa rjes 'brel gyi rkyen dang*/ ya sgra la dang*/ byings thams cad pa'i dbyangs yon tan can la dang*/ a d+ya ta nī dang*/ ā shīṣa sogs la dang*/ byings thams cad pa yin min sogs la dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tsaṇa dang*/ aṇa dang*/ yaṇa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyi nang tshan ṇa yig rjes su 'brel ba rnams dang*/ tse kṝ yi ta'i ming can/ ya sgra rnams pha rol tu 'byung ba dag la/ nā mi'i mtha' dang*/ de'i u pa nghā dang*/ bi ka ra ṇa rnams yon tan 'gyur ba min no/ /ṇī& thob/ ṇu bstod/ te| yaṇa/ 'dis yon tan bkag cing*/ nā mi mtha' rnams kyi yaṇa/ zhes pas ring po'o/ /nī ya te/ u pa nghā nā mi la/ pu ṣa rgyas/ nghuta gsal/ di aṭa/ pu ṣa sogs kyis aṇa/ 'dis yon tan med pas/ a pu ṣata/ a dhu tata/ ṇīnya thob| pu ṣa rgyas/ li ha ro myang*/ ya sgra/ 'dis yon tan med/ gnyis brjod/ ne nī ya te/ bo bhū ya te/ pau su ṣ+ya te/ le li h+ya te/ gnyis pa ni/ a bh+yā sar ma zad| a bh+yasta'i'ang*/ u pa nghā nā min gyi dbyangs ni/ byings thams cad pa'i rkyen| yon tan can dbyangs dang po pha rol la yon tan du mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni rkyen la yon tan yod kyang*/ byings kyi ngos nas bkag pa'o/ /ṇi dzir dgabi dzir tha dad/ bi ṣl̥ khyab/ pañca mī'i ā ni dang*/ h+yasta nī'i am/

an bi dzu ho ti sogs las 'jigaganyis brjod/ ni dzi bi dzi sogs kyis/ a bh+yā sa yon tan| 'dis a bh+yasta yon tan med/ ne ni dzā ni/ a ne ni dzam/ be bi dzā ni/ a be bi dzam/ be bi ṣā ni/ a be bi ṣam/ 'dir h+yasta nī'i an rkyen du byin zhing*/ grub 'bras la'ang*/ dzan la sogs pa 'byung ba ni/ yi ge ma dag par mngon te/ an ni gnyis nyid dang*/ mang po nyid la zhes sogs su yon tan bkag la/ 'dir ni yon tan can dbyangs dang po la zhes bshad pa'i 'bru snon dang 'gal bas so/ /yang na ni/ an us su bsgyur bas na yon tan 'byung bas an yang yon tan can gyi rkyen du/ bsdus par mngon no/ /'di'i thad du/ slob phan du/ nag 'byam mang po zhig 'byung mod kyi/ go bde ba mi 'dug pas brtag par bya'o/ /gzhan yang u pa nghā nā min gyi byings la san la'ang iṭa yod na yon tan du 'gyur yang*/ san iṭa med pa la yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /bhi dir rnam par 'joms/ bud ngha rtogs/ tum/ san/ 'jiga.a di tu/ di zhes pa dang*/ ra nghi ru nghi/ zhes pas iṭa med/ gnyis brjod sogs/ byings kyi gsum pa dang po sogs kyis/ ba'i bha/ sgra med pa rnams la zhes pas ngha'i ta/ ti an bi/ a dang mtshams sbyor sogs/ bi bhit+sa ti/ bu bhut+sa ti/ iṭa yod pa ni/ ku ṣa nges par bkug pa la san iṭa dang bcas pas/ tsu ko ṣi ṣa ti zhes so/ /gsum pa ni| u pa nghā nā min gyi byings gzhir byas nas/ iṭa med pa'i sitsa dang*/ ā shīṣa dag pha rol la/ yon tan du mi 'gyur te/ de yang āt+ma ne la'o/ /bhi dir rnam par 'joms/ ts+tshi dir gnyis su byed/ budha rtogs/ a d+ya ta nī'i ta si tsa/ 'dis yon tan med/ nghuṭa las kyang nghuṭa las so/ /zhes pas sitsa 'jigaru nghir sogs kyis iṭa med/ gha ḍha sogs kyis ta'i ngha/ nghuṭa rnams kyi bzhi pa rnams la gsum pa rnams so/ /zhes pas ngha'i da/ a bhit+ta/ a ts+tshit+ta/ a bung+ngha/ bhid/

ā tām/ an+ta/ sitsa/ a yig ma yin pa sogs kyis/ an+ta'i na dbyi/ sgra med pa rnams la sogs kyis da'i ta/ a bhit+sā taṃ/ a bhit+sa ta*/ ts+tshid bud/ ā shīṣa'i āt+ma ne'i sīṣ+ta/ i di/ tu di sogs kyis iṭa med/ byings kyi gsum pa dang po sogs sngar bzhin/ ts+tshit+sīṣ+ta/ bhut+sīṣ+ta/ iṭa yod na muṭa rab tu nyed/ ta/ sitsa dang*/ sīṣ+ta/ byings thams cad pa min pa sogs kyis/ iṭa/ yon tan/ a mo ṭiṣ+ta/ mo ṭi ṣīṣ+ta/ bshad ma thag pa'i rnam dbye khyad chos can gnyis la/ byings ṛta mtha' rnams kyi'ang yon tan du mi gyur te/ ḍukrinya/ ta/ ā tām/ ān+ta/ sitsa/ dang po la thung ngu las kyang sitsa dbyi ba sogs byas/ a kṛ ta/ a kṛ ṣā tām/ a kṛ ṣa ta/ sīṣ+ta sbyar na/ kṛṣī ṣ+ta rnam dbye bshad ma thag pa la ṣ+ṭhā 'gro ba las ldog pa'i lus 'gyur/ s+thā dang ḍudānya/ sbyin/ ḍu nghānya sbyin/ zhes pa dag gi nā mi mtha'i byings kyang yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /byings de gnyis nā mi mtha'i can min no zhe na/ bden mod kyi/ 'og nas/ s+thā dā dag gi a d+ya ta nī la|

āt+ma ne la i'o/ /zhes a d+ya ta nī la/ ā i ru bsgyur ba nā mi mtha' can du 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di ā shīṣa la mi srid pa'i phyir yon tan gyi dwogs pa med pas/ bu ṭika tu/ sīṣ+ta la'ang*/ 'di sbyar ba ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i bya ba mangs pas mad do/ /des na/ iṭa med pa'i a d+ya ta nī/ sitsa dang bcas pa la 'di sbyar zhing*| byings dang po la saṃ sngon dang*/ gnyis ka la dang por aṭa sogs sngar bzhin byas pas/ sa mas+thi ṣā tām/ sa mas+thi ṣa ta/ a di ta sogs dang*/ a nghi ta sogs so/ /bhū yod pa'i byings ni/ sitsa 'jig pa la yon tan med do/ /bhū/ di| tām/ an/ sitsa/ iṇa s+thā zhes sogs kyis pa rasmai la sitsa 'jigabhū'i mtha' zhes sogs kyi ba ā ga ma bhū las sitsa 'jig pa la'o/ /zhes pas iṭa med/ a bhū ba tām/ a bhū ban/ dang po gnyis la brtsegs pa dang po'i nghuṭa phyis pa'o/ /sitsa mi 'jig pa la/ bhū bya ta sngon ta dang por aṭa/ sitsa/ iṭa/ yon tan/ bya ta/ bha biṣ+ta sū ti zhes pa/ ṣung srog chags mngal nas grol zhes pa'i byings las/ pañca mi/ pha rol la yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /ai/ ā ba hai/ ā ma hai/ dbyangs dang po la u ba/ su bai su bā hai/ su bā ma hai/ dī nghī/ be bī/ zhes pa'i dī nghī gsal ba dang rtse/ be bīng rngan pa mtshungs pa zhes pa dag gi byings mtha' 'ang*/ yon tan du mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni/ pañca mī kho na la mi sbyor te/ sbyor na 'og nas gzhan 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs gzhan mi 'dug pas| snga ma dang 'jug pa gcig tu bya bar rigs pas so/ /des na byings de gnyis la/ kṛta kyi yuṭa/ yu'i a nang nga dbyangs don/ snga ma brtsegs pa min pa zhes pas/ byings mtha'i i gnyis ya ru byas pa'o/ /mthar si mu'o/ /āng sngon/ ā dī ngh+ya naṃ/ ā be bya naṃ/ pañca mī'i rkyen snga ma gsum dang sbyar na/ ā dī ngh+yai/ ā dī dh+yā ba hai/ ā dī ngh+yā ma hai sogs so/ /san pha rol la/ tud bid muṣa zhes pas|

ru dir mchi ma 'dzagabid shes/ muṣa rku zhes pa rnams kyi dbyangs dang*| dīng zad/ ṇīnya thob/ hu sbyin pa sogs la 'og nas iṭa bkag pas/ de lta bu'i byings iṭa med pa'i/ nā mi mtha' rnams kyi dbyangs yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /byings de rnams la/ tum san 'jigaganyis brjod sogs/ mdo snga ma la iṭa dang bcas pa byas pas ru ru de ṣa ti/ bi bi di ṣa ti/ mu mu ṣi ṣa ti/ byings phyi ma gnyis la/ dbyangs mtha' rnams kyi san la'o/ /zhes pas ring por btang bas/ di dī ṣa ti/ ni nī ṣa te/ dzu hū ṣa ti/ bzhi pa la byings thams cad pa la dang*/ de min pa la dang*/ sna tshogs la yon tan dgag pa'/ོ/ dang po ni/ byings dang bi ka ra ṇa thams cad kyi/ pañca mī'i skyes bu phyi ma gsum po min pa'i byings thams cad pa rnams kyi āt+ma ne rnams la yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /ṣ+tu?nya bstod/ brta mā nī'i te/ sap+ta mī'i īta/ pañca mī'i tām/ h+yasta nī'i ta/ an bi/ ad sogs las 'jiga'adis yon tan med/ byings kyi ī'i yi ge zhes pas/ īd la/ u ba/ sū te/ sū bīta/ sū tāṃ/ a stu ta/ du ha 'jo| rkyen de bzhi/ da dngapo'i ha'i gha/ gha ḍha zhes pas ta'i ngha/ nghuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas gha'i ga'adis yon tan med pas/ dug+nghe/ du hī ta/ dug dhāṃ/ a dug+ngha/ de rnams kyi byings la yon tan med pa'i dper brjod yin la/ bi ka ra ṇa'i/ ḍukṛnya rkyen de bzhi/ u bi/ byings thams cad pa yon tan med pa la a'i u yig byas/ ku ru te/ ku rbīta/ ku tu tāṃ/ a ku ru ta/ pañca mī'i phyi ma ai/ ā ba hai/ ā ma hai/ ṣ+tunya bstod pa la byin na/ sta bai/ sta bā ba hai/ sta bā ma hai/ 'o na byings thams cad pa'i pa rasmai kun la yon tan thob bam zhe na/ byings thams cad pa'i gnyis nyid dang mang po nyid kyi tshig dag la ni pa rasmai la'ang yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /'di la'ang pañca mī'i phyi ma min pa zhes pa 'jug pas rnam dbye de'i pa rasmai'i/

phyi ma gsum la'ang yon tan thob bo/ /ṣ+tu/ duha/ kṛ/ ṣu/ warta mā na'i tas/ an+ti/ pañca mī'i tām/ an+tu/ h+yasta nī'i tām/ an/ byings dang po gnyis la an bi/ ad sogs las 'jigakṛ la u/ su la nu/ mang tshig la/ bi ka ra ṇa'i nu'i wa/ sū taḥ stu ban+ti/ sū tāṃ/ sū ban+tu/ a stu tāṃ/ a stu ban/ dug+nghaḥ duhan+ti/ dug+nghāṃ du han+tu/ a dug+nghām/ a du han/ ku ru taḥ kurban+ti/ ku ru tām/ kurban+tu/ a ku ru tām/ a kurban/ su nu taḥ su n+wan+ti/ su nu tām/ su n+wan+tu/ a su nu tām/ a su n+wan/ gnyis pa ni/ pa ro3k+ṣā la'ang*/ pa rasmai'i gnyis tshig dang*/ mang tshig la yon tan du mi 'gyur te/ kṛ a tus us/ tsa kra tuḥ tsa kruḥ pa ro3k+ṣā'i āt+ma ne'i/ gcig tshigaganyis tshigamang tshig thams cad la yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /kṛ e/ ā te/ i re/ tsakre/ tsakrā te/ tsa kri re/ ā shī ṣa dag las pa rasmai'i tshig thams cad la yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /ṣ+tunya/ yāta/ yā taṃ/ yā sus/ stū yāta/ stu yā tāṃ/ sū yā suḥ nā mi mtha' rnams kyi yin ā yi sogs kyis ya la ring po'o zhes pa byas pa'o/ /byings thams cad pa yin kyang sap+ta mī'i pa rasmai'i tshig gsum la'ang yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /yus ces pa ma gtogs snga ma bzhin no// pañca mī'i hi la'ang yon tan med do/ /stu hi/ dug+nghi/ ṣ+tu/ du ha hi/ an bi 'jigad dang po'i ha'i gha/ ha'i nghi/ gsum pa ni/ tud sogs ces pa/ tu da gzir/ ṇud ded/ ti/ an bi/ tu da ti/ nud ti/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i cha shas/ tsa kās sogs las/ pa ro3k+ṣā la āma'o/ /zhes uṣa bid dzā gṛ rnams la yang na'o zhes pa'i ām pha rol la'ang*/ bid ces pa bid shes pa la'o zhes pa 'di nyid kyi yon tan du mi 'gyur ro/ /bid/ aṭa/ āṃ/ kṛnya/ rjes su sbyar/ kṛ de gnyis brjod do/ /a bh+yasta 'phel ba/ tsan+t+ra par ra'i la'o zhes pas/ kār gyi ra la ru bsgyur bas/ bi dāṃ tsa kā la/ kuṭa 'khyog ces pa nas/ kung sgra la'o zhes pa'i bar ni/

kuṭa sogs yin la/ byings de rnams kyi dbyangs ni/ in dang*/ itsa dang*| aṭa rnams min pa'i rkyen kun la yon tan du mi 'gyur zhing de gsum la 'gyur ro/ /byings de gnyis la/ shwasta nī'i tā/ byings thams cad pa min pa sogs kyis iṭa/ ku ṭi tā/ kwi tā/ o bi dzī 'jigs pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i ī rjes 'brel byas pa'i dbyangs ni/ iṭa la yon tan du mi 'gyur bas/ rkyen snga ma la/ bi dzi tā/ slob phan du/ ūr+ṇu3 'gebs pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings mtha'i u yig yang na yon tan du mi 'gyur la yang na 'gyur ro/ /nya rjes 'brel tā iṭa/ dbyangs la ū ba'i yon tan gang rung byas pas/ ur+ṇa bi tā/ gnyis pa zhar byung rnam 'gyur gzhan bshad pa la/ bsgyur ba dang*/ ā ga ma dang*/ dbyi ba dang*/ slar yang bsgyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ s+thā gnas pa la'o/ /ḍu dānya sbyin pa la'o/ /zhes pa 'di gnyis dag gi a d+ya ta nī la/ āt+ma ne pha rol la/ byings kyi ā ring po i ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /byings dang po la saṃ dang*/ gnyis ka la aṭa sngon du/ ta/ ā tāṃ/ sitsa thung ngu las kyang iṭa med pa'i'o zhes pas/ sitsa nghuṭa la dbyi ba byas pas sa ma s+thi ta/ sa ma s+thi ṣā tāṃ/ a di ta/ a di ṣā tāṃ/ gnyis pa ni| mutsa zhes pa/ mu thar pa la'o zhes pa nas/ bi sha cha shas la'o zhes pa'i bar ni/ mutsa sogs kyi byings yin la/ de rnams dbyangs las pha rol tu an bi ka ra ṇa la na yig dbyangs med kyi ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis la/ ti te| an sde pa la sde pa'i mtha'/ muñca ti/ muñca te/ bing sha ti/ biṃ sha te/ ma na sha zhes pa ḍu ma dgaṇa sha mi mthong zhes pa dag gi mthar/ nghuṭa la na ā ga ma'o/ /tā/ iṭa med/ nghuṭa rnams kyi zhes pas sa'i da ta'i sde ces pas da dza bras+dzi mas+dza dag gi dhuṭa la'o zhes pas dza yig phyi ma dbyi/ tsa sde ki sde pa la de'i mtha' rnams byas pas/ snga ma la/ maṅk+tā*/ phyi ma la tsha sha dag gi'ang ngo*/ ṣa dang ṭa sde las zhes sogs byas pas/

naṣ+tāṃ/ ra nghi zhes pa ra ngha 'tshe| dza bha lus rnam par nyams zhes pa 'di dag gi in kā ri ta sogs kyi dbyangs la na ā ga ma'o/ /ran+dha ya ti/ dzam+bha ya ti/ ti/ an bi/ yon tan byas pa'o/ /'on kyang ra nghi'i iṭa ā ga ma la/ rnam dbye pa ro3k+ṣā ma 'gyur kyang*/ de min pa la na ā ga ma ma yin pas mi 'gyur ro/ /tā/ iṭa/ ra nghi tā/ ra bhi zhes pa| ra bha rtsom/ ḍu la bhaṣa thob ces pa 'di dag gi bi ka ra ṇa dang*/ pa ro3k+ṣā dag min pa'i dbyangs la na ā ga ma 'gyur ro/ /de gnyis la in kā ri ta/ te/ an bi/ yon tan/ ram+bha ya ti/ lam+bha ya ti/ hu sbyin/ tsa kā sṛ 'bar ba'i byings| ṛ rjes 'brel byas pa lta bu'i byings nghuṭa mtha' can dag las/ rkyen pañca mī'i hi yig nghi ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /de gnyis la/ hi an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs kyis 'jig/gnyis brjod sogs/ nghuṭa rnams kyi gsum pa la 'os sa'i da/ dzu hu nghi/ tsa kā nghi/ asti zhes pa a sa yod pa'i byings las hi/ an bi| ad sogs las 'jiga.asti'i dang po'o zhes pas/ a dbyi/ dā asti dag gi e zhes pas sa yig e ru bsgyur bas/ e nghi/ shāsti zhes pa/ shā su rjes su ston pa las hi nghi dang*/ byings sha ru bsgyur ba yang bya'o/ /hi an bi 'jig pas| shā nghi/ gsum pa ni/ a bh+yasta las/ an+ti zhes pa/ an+ti/ an+tu/ sogs kyis na yig dbyi bar bya'o/ /ḍu dānya/ an+ti/ an+tu/ an bi/ dzu ho ti sogs kyis 'jigaganyis thung ngu*/ a bh+yasta rnams kyi ā yig go zhes pas/ ā phyis pas/ da da ti/ da da tu/ ḍu kṛnya sogs/ byings mtha' a yig min pa las| āt+ma ne'i/ an+ti'i na dbyi'o/ /kṛ/ an+te/ kṝ sogs las nu tan sogs las u/ ka ro ti'i yon tan/ kurba te/ she ti zhes pa/ shīng nyal ba'i byings las an+ti'i dang por ṛ yig ā ga ma 'gyur zhing*/ ṛ'i i brjod don/ 'dir an+ti zhes pa/ an+ti/ an+tām/ an+ta kun la zer bas/ she ra te/ she ra tām/

she ra ta/ phyi ma la a d+ya ta ni y-in na/ a she ra ta zhes pa'o/ /bit+ti zhes pa/ bid shes pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las pha rol gyi brta mā na'i pa rasmai dgu'i rnam dbye rnams/ pa ro3k+ṣā'i aṭa sogs dgu po rnams su yang na 'gyur ro/ /pa ro3k+ṣār gyur kyang gnas can dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ brta mā na'i gnas so zhes pas gnyis brjod pa'i cho ga rnams mi bya'o/ /des na grub 'bras ni/ be da| bi da tuḥ bi duḥ bet+thaḥ bi da thuḥ bi da/ be da/ bid+ba/ bid+ma/ yang na/ bit+ti/ bit+taḥ bi dan+ti/ bet+si/ bit+thaḥ bit+tha/ bed+mi/ bid+baḥ bid+maḥ brunya gsal bar brjod pa la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings ni/ brta mā na'i dang po lnga rnams la ā ha zhes par 'gyur zhing*/ 'ang sgras rnam dbye rnams kyang*/ aṭa sogs su yang na 'gyur ba'o/ /ā ha/ ā ha tuḥ a huḥ ā / ā ha thuḥ yang na ti sogs yon tan can la/ brū las ngag dang por īṭa'o byas pas bra bī ti/ brū taḥ bru ban+ti/ bra bī ṣi/ brū thaḥ byings de thal la'i ā ha ru bsgyur zhing*/ de'i ha yig tha ru bsgyur bar bya'o/ /mdo de gsum ni slob phan las 'byung ngo*/ /byings ā yig mtha' can las/ a ṭa'i au ru bsgyur bar bya ste/ pā btung*| yā thob/ dā sbyin/ mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge la'ang ngos/ ā phyis shing*/ gnyis brjod sogs byas pas/ pa pau/ ya yau/ da dau/ ṝṃ ra ces pa byings ṝ yig ring po'i mtha' ni/ rkyen yon tan med pa la ir du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /kṝ g.yang*| gṝ gsal/ ti an bi/ tud sogs las yon tan med/ ki ra ti/ gi ra ti/ 'on kyang*/ mchur gyur zhes pa pa sde'i u pa nghā'i ṝ yig ring po ni/ rkyen de la ur du bsgyur bar bya'o/ /sṛ skyong*/ bh+ṝ brgyad bkagate/ yaṇa/ nā mi'i ra ba dag la ring po/ pur+ya te/ bhur+ya te/ byings gang yin kyang rung ste/ rkyen in kā ri ta dang*/ a d+ya ta nī'i cha shas tsaṇa pha rol la mtshungs pa ma phyis na/

spyir in ma u pa nghā ring por byed kyang*/ 'dir thung ngo*/ /pa tsa 'tshed/ pa ṭha gsal bar brjod/ in/ 'dis tsan/ tsaṇa la in dbyi/ gnyis brjod/ mtshungs pa ma phyis na zhes pas/ a nyid dang yang ba'i ring po'o/ /a pī pa tsata/ a pī pa thar/ byings kyi cha shas las mtshungs pa'i ming can gyi yi ge phyis na 'dir mi 'gyur ro/ /iṇa dang tsaṇa la yang shā su rjes su ston pa dang*/ ṛta thung ngu*| rjes su 'brel pa ḍhau kṛ 'gro ba'i don dang*/ ṭu yā tsṛ slong ba la'o/ /zhes pa lta bu rnams kyi u pa nghā thung ngur 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /in di/ tsaṇa/ ka ri ta dbyi| gnyis brjod/ thung ngu 'os au yig gi u gnyis pa bzhi pa sogs/ a sha shā sa ta/ a pī pya taṃ/ a pi pyan/ in/ tsaṇa la pi ba ti'i ming can/ pā btung ba zhes pa u pa nghā dbyi ste/ a bh+ya sa'i dbyangs īta nyid du 'gyur ro// in byā sa rnams kyi in la zhes pas byings kyi dbyangs ā yar bsgyur/ di taṃ/ an| tsaṇa kā ri ta dbyi/ gnyis brjod sogs/ a'i yang dbyi'os/ an la tsaṇa gyi a phyis pa rnams byas pas/ a pī pya tam/ ā pī pyan/ i na tsaṇa la/ tiṣ+ṭha ti'i ming can/ s+thā gnas pa'i u pa nghā it thung ngur 'gyur ro/ /in/ at+ti hri zhes pas pa yig ā ga ma/ di/ tsaṇa/ kā ri ta dbyi/ gnyis brjod sogs/ mtshungs pa ma phyis na/ zhes sogs kyis/ a bh+ya sa'i a yig i/ a tiṣ+ṭhi pata dzi gh+ra ti'i ming can/ gh+ra dri len pa'i u pa nghā ni de dag la yang na i nyid du 'gyur ro/ /in/ sa yig ā ga ma/ di tsaṇa/ gnyis brjod sogs a da dzi gh+ri pata/ yang na/ a dzi gh+ra pata/ 'di la'ang a bh+yā sa ni/ mtshungs pa ma phyis/ zhes pa kun bshad rkang pa lnga pa'i rnam par bshad pa rdzogs so// //drug pa zhar byung a nu ṣaṃ ga dbyi ba dang*/ 'phel ba'i rnam gzhag dngos dang*| de'i 'phros don yon tan dang*/ rnam 'gyur sna tshaugs rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ita ces pa byings thung ngu rjes su 'brel pa ma yin pa shran+su/

bh+ran+su 'og tu lhung*/ ngh+wan+su 'gro/ zhes sogs rnams kyi na a nu ṣaṅga ni rkyen yon tan med pa pha rol la dbyi bar bya'o/ /byings gsum gyi u brjod don/ te/ yaṇa| shra s+ya te/ bh+ra s+ya te/ byings de gsum la/ ya sgra gnyis brjod sogs/ wañci/ shrin+sa sogs kyis nī ā ga ma'o/ /tse kṝ yi ta'i mtha' las te/ an bi/ a dang mtshams sbyor sogs/ shanī shra s+ya te/ ba nī/ bh+ra s+ya te/ dā nī/ bh+ra s+ya te/ da nī dh+wa s+ya te/ byings de gsum la kṛta kyi niṣ+ṭhā'i k+ta/ bh+ran+sa la/ sha tsha dag gi 'ang ngo zhes pas sa'i ṣa/ ṣa dang ṭa sde sogs/ si rnam bshad/ prasta/ bh+raṣ+ta/ ngh+wasta/ rkyen gyi ka yig ka la yaṇa sogs te/ ka nga rjes 'brel gyi rkyen la yon tan med do| |ita rjes su 'brel na/ ba di srong por smra ba/ num te/ yaṇa/ ban+t+ya te/ rkyen la yon tan yod na/ shran+sa/ shwastā nī'i tā/ iṭa/ shran+si tā/ 'o na 'dir 'phyid bya'i a nu ṣaṃ ga yin na/ rkyen gyi tshul rol yin pa dang*/ byings i rjes su ma 'brel ba dang*/ rkyen yon tan med pa gsum tshang dgos sam snyam na/ mi dgos te/ byings i rjes 'brel gyi num ā ga ma'i ngo bor gyur pa'i a nu ṣaṃ ga ni| rkyen gyi cha shas kyis na sgra las kyang pha rol tu 'byung bas/ de 'phyid cing*/ de yang na sgra bi ka ra ṇa yin pa las so/ /hi si 'tshe/ num/ ti/ ru ngha sogs kyis dbyangs las pha rol tu na sgra/ hi nan+sa/ 'di na a nu ṣaṃ ga dang*/ ru ngha sogs kyis bi ka ra ṇa'i mtha' dbyi'o zhes pas/ na sgra'i dbyangs phyis pas hin+si/ ma na nghuṭa/ la rjes su nga ro byas na/ haṃsti ki i

'bar/ shran+thi/ gran+thi/ dan+bhi zhes pa shran+tha dang gran+tha gzhung sgrigadan+bhu tshul 'chos zhes pa'i byings rnams kyi a nu ṣaṃ ga ni pa ro3k+ṣā pha rol la 'phyid de de yang yon tan med pa la 'ang ngo*/ /byings dang po la e/ gnyis brjod sogs/ mtshungs pa'i ring po/ sam sngon/ sa mī nghe/ byings phyi ma gsum la/ a thus/ us/ gnyis brjod/ tṛ phal bha dza sogs kyi a bh+yā sa dbyi zhing*/ dbyangs e ru bsgyur bas/ shre tha thuḥ shre thu sogs so/ /'dir slob phan du/ byings tha ma gsum gyi thal yang*/ iṭa dang bcas pa la a nu ṣaṃ ga dbyi bas/ shre thi tha sogs su bshad do/ /dan+ni/ san+dzi/ sran+dzi/ ran+dzi zhes pa/ dan+sha mche/ ṣan+dza chags/ shwan+dza yongs su 'khyud/ rañja chos/ ti/ an bi/ sogs sbyar ba'i tshe/ byings de rnams kyi a nu ṣaṃ ga ni/ an pha rol la dbyi bar bya'o/ /da sha ti/ sa dza ti/ swa dza ti/ ra dza ti/ gnyis pa ni/ in kā ri ta dang*/ a d+ya ta nī'o/ /cha shas i tsa dang pa ro3k+ṣā'i aṭa rnams pha rol la byings kyi a'i u pa nghā ring por 'gyur te/ byings kyi nā mi rnams kyi'ang 'phel ba'o/ /ḍupa tsa/ ya dza lha mchod/ tsinya sogs/ ṇīnya thob/ hu sbyin/ in te/ an bi/ yon tan/ pā tsa ya ti/ yā dza ya ti/ tsā ya ya ti/ nā ya ya ti/ hā ba ya ti/ byings de rnams la a d+ya ta nī ta/ dngos po dang las dag la'ang ngos/ itsa/ itsa las ta dbyi bas/ a pā tsi/ a yā tsi sogs so/ /de rnams la pa ro3k+ṣā'i aṭa/ gnyis brjod sogs/ pa pā tsa sogs dang tsi tsā ya/ dzu hā ba sogs so/ /'dir bstan gyi bya ba byed pa'i rkyen la/ in sogs gsum phyis pas ma khyab ste/ byings dbyangs mtha' can rnams kyi dbyangs ni sitsa pha rol la 'phel bar 'gyur la/ de yang sitsa 'dren byed pa rasmai yin pa la der 'gyur bas so/ /tsinya sogs/ 'dis sitsa/ sitsa las so zhes pas de dang de'i bar du īṭa/ a tsai ṣīta/ byings gsal byed mtha' can rnams kyi iṭa med pa'i nā mi ni/

si tsa la 'phel ba'o/ /bhi dir rnam par 'joms/ ts+tshi dir gnyis su byed/ ti si tsa/ a di tu di zhes pas iṭa med/ sitsa las so zhes pas pha rol tu īṭa/ a bhait+sīta/ a ts+tshait+sīta/ sgra med pa rnams la zhes pas/ byings kyi da yig ta'o/ /byings dang rkyen de 'dra la/ nā mi 'phel bar 'gyur na/ a yig cir 'gyur zhe na/ a'i 'ang ring po'o/ /patsa 'tshed/ di/ sitsa iṭa/ ang k+ṣīta/ ba da gsal bar brjod/ bra dza 'gro zhes pa dang tsa ra 'gro /pha la rdzogs zhes sogs/ ra dang la'i mtha' can/ a'i upa nghā rnams kyi yang sitsa dang pa rasmai pha rol la ring por 'gyur ro/ /rkyen snga ma ji bzhin byas pas/ a bā dita/ a brā dzī ta/ a tsā rīta/ a phā līta/ 'on kyang 'di rnams la sitsa'i gong du iṭa 'byung ba la/ iṭa las kyang īṭa la'o zhes pas/ si tsa phyis nas mtshungs 'dra byas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni de lta bu'i sitsa pha rol la byings kyi nā mi thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ ṭu au shwi 'gro ba 'phel/ dzā gṝ gnyid sad ces pa 'di dag gi dbyangs ni rkyen bshad ma thag pa de lta bu la yon tan du 'gyur bas so/ /yon tan dang mtshams sbyor byas pas a shwa yīta/ a dzā ga rīta/ 'dir slob phan du/ ū ti'i yang na'o/ /zhes pa ū nya 'gebs zhes pa 'di'i rkyen de la yon tan du yang na 'gyur bas/ pra sngon du gzhagapra bīta/ yon tan ma byas pa la u ba byas pa'o/ /arti parti zhes pa ṛ dang sṛ 'gro ba zhes pa 'di dag gi a d+ya ta nī cha shas aṇa pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur ba'o/ /ṇa yig rjes 'brel la yon tan bkag pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /di/ puṣa sogs zhes pas aṇa/ at+ti la/ a yig ā yig dang*/ sat+ti la/ dang por aṭa byas pas/ ā rata/ a sa rata/ byings kyi nā mi yin na kā ri ta la 'phel bar 'gyur bas khyab bam zhe na/ ma khyab ste/ dza ga rti zhes pa dzā gṛ gnyid sad pa'i byings dag gi kā ri ta la yon tan du 'gyur bas so/

/in/ ti/ an bi| yon tan/ dzā ga ra ya ti/ byings de yaṇa bi ka ra ṇa dang*/ rnam dbye a shī ṣa dag la ya la'ang yon tan du 'gyur te/ dzā gar+yāta/ byings de pa ro3k+ṣā la ni yon tan med pa la'ang yon tan du 'gyur te/ a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod sogs/ dza dzā ga ra tuḥ dza dzā ga ruḥ rkyen de la ni/ brtsegs pa dang po'/ི/ rita kyi yang yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /sbṛ sgra la'o/ /ngh+wi gnod pa la'o/ /zhes pa la/ a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod sogs/ sa swa ra tuḥ sa swa ruḥ da ngha ra tuḥ da ngha ru/ rkyen de la/ ḍu kṛnya sogs/ ṛta mtha' can rnams kyi'ang yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /tsa ka ra tuḥ rkyen de la/ ṛts+tsha dbang po nyams pa la'o zhes pa 'di'i rita kyi'ang yon tan du 'gyur ro/ /a tus/ us/ gnyis brjod/ ṛ yig gi a yig dang po'i a'i thams cad du'o zhes pas ring po ṛ yig la'ang ngo zhes pas/ ā ga ma a nar ts+tsha tuḥ ā nar ts+tshuḥ shīng nyal ba la'o zhes pa'i byings thams cad pa pha rol la yon tan du 'gyur te/ de yang āt+ma ne ma bkag pa'i dmigs bsal lo/ /des na byings thams cad pa bzhi'i āt+ma ne'i te/ īta/ tām/ ta/ an bi/ a da sogs las 'jigashe te/ sha yīta/ she tāṃ/ a she ta/ byings de yon tan med pa'i yang pha rol la dbyangs ī ni ā yi ru bsgyur zhing*/ ā yi'i i brjod don/ de la ya sgra/ gnyis brjod/ gsal lhag ā ga ma med pa'i ring po/ te/ an bi/ a dang mtshams sbyor sogs so| |sha shay+yate/ bzhi pa la bsgyur ba dang*/ dbyi ba dang*/ slar yang bsgyur ba dang*| ā ga ma sogs kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ḍu dānya dang*/ pā btung ba sogs byings āta ces pa/ ā yig ring po'i mtha' can rnams kyi ā ni/ a d+ya ta nī'i cha shas i tsa pha rol ā yi zhes par bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ta itsa/ itsa las ta dbyi/ ā dā yi/ a pā yi/ sho phra mor byed/ ts+tsho gcod/ ṣo mtha'i las/ hwe nya 'gran/ bye nya sngom/ benya snal ma'i rgyud/ ces pa rnams mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i mtha' rnams kyi zhes sogs kyi bsgyur ba'i lus 'gyur/
